explain_zh: 第48條：驗證機構、監測機構、醫療機構、勞工健康服務專業機構、訓練單位或顧問服務機構違反各該授權辦法或規則者，予以警告或處新臺幣六萬元以上三十萬元以下罰鍰，並得限期令其改正。訓練單位所違反者為依第32條第3項所定之規則。第49條規定有第48條情形者，應公布其名稱及負責人姓名。
explain_en: Article 48 covers verification, monitoring, medical, health service, training and consulting bodies.

law: 職業安全衛生法
q_zh: 第四十八條所列之機構或單位，經限期令其改正而屆期未改正，或情節重大者，主管機關得再為何種處分？
a_zh: 得公告其違規紀錄，或命其停止收費並退還已收費用
b_zh: 得移送法院裁定解散，或沒入其全部之檢查儀器設備
c_zh: 得撤銷或廢止其認可，或定期停止其業務之全部或一部
d_zh: 得加倍處以罰鍰，或命其負責人接受安全衛生之講習
q_en: If such a body fails to correct in time or the case is serious, what further sanction may be imposed?
a_en: Its violation record may be announced, or it may be told to stop charging and refund fees
b_en: It may be referred to court for dissolution, or all its inspection instruments confiscated
c_en: Its accreditation may be revoked or annulled, or its business suspended in whole or in part
d_en: The fine may be doubled, or its responsible person ordered to attend safety and health classes
explain_zh: 第48條：屆期未改正或情節重大者，得撤銷或廢止其認可，或定期停止其業務之全部或一部。其處分對象包括違反第8條第5項辦法之驗證機構、違反第12條第5項辦法之監測機構、違反第20條第4項及第5項辦法之醫療機構、違反第22條第3項規則之勞工健康服務專業機構、違反第32條第3項規則之訓練單位及違反第36條第3項規則之顧問服務機構。
explain_en: Article 48, latter part.

law: 職業安全衛生法
q_zh: 依本法規定，發生下列何種情形時，應公布事業單位、雇主或相關機構之名稱及其負責人姓名？
a_zh: 發生第三十七條第二項之災害、有第四十條至第四十五條、第四十七條或第四十八條之情形，或發生職業病
b_zh: 僅限發生勞工死亡之職業災害，且經法院判決有罪確定並由中央主管機關認定情節重大者
c_zh: 事業單位連續二年未依規定實施勞工健康檢查，或未依規定設置職業安全衛生管理單位者
d_zh: 勞工申訴案件經查證屬實，且事業單位對該申訴之勞工終止勞動契約或為其他不利之處分
q_en: In which situation must the name and responsible person of an enterprise or body be made public?
a_en: An Article 37-2 disaster, any case under Articles 40 to 45, 47 or 48, or an occupational disease
b_en: Only a fatal accident that has been finally convicted by a court and deemed serious by the ministry
c_en: Failure to arrange health examinations for two straight years, or to set up a safety unit
d_en: A proven worker complaint where the employer then terminated or otherwise disadvantaged them
explain_zh: 第49條：發生第37條第2項之災害、有第40條至第45條、第47條或第48條之情形，或發生職業病者，應公布事業單位、雇主、代行檢查機構、驗證機構、監測機構、醫療機構、勞工健康服務專業機構、訓練單位或顧問服務機構之名稱、負責人姓名。第37條第2項所定災害包括死亡災害、罹災三人以上及罹災一人以上需住院治療者。
explain_en: Article 49, Paragraph 1.

law: 職業安全衛生法
q_zh: 依本法應公布名稱之情形，除名稱及負責人姓名外，尚應併同公布哪些事項？
a_zh: 經處罰鍰者公布繳納期限及繳款帳號；屬災害情形者並公布罹災勞工姓名、年齡及其所屬承攬人名稱
b_zh: 經處罰鍰者公布歷年累計處分次數；屬災害情形者並公布事業單位地址、資本額及其勞工總人數
c_zh: 經處罰鍰者公布處分期日、違反條文及罰鍰金額；屬災害或違規情形者並公布災害發生日期、發生地及罹災人數
d_zh: 經處罰鍰者公布處分機關及救濟期間；屬災害情形者並公布災害類型、事故原因及預估之財物損失金額
q_en: Besides names, what else must be published?
a_en: For fines: the payment deadline and bank account; for disasters: victims names, ages and contractor
b_en: For fines: the cumulative number of past penalties; for disasters: address, capital and total workers
c_en: For fines: the date, the article breached and the amount; for disasters: date, place and number injured
d_en: For fines: the deciding agency and appeal period; for disasters: type, cause and estimated property loss
explain_zh: 第49條：經主管機關處以罰鍰者，應公布該罰鍰處分之處分期日、違反條文及罰鍰金額；符合第1項第1款（發生第37條第2項災害）或第2款（有第40條至第45條、第47條、第48條情形）者，並應公布職業災害之發生日期、發生地及罹災人數。第3款之發生職業病則不須公布災害資訊。
explain_en: Article 49, Paragraphs 1 and 2.

law: 職業安全衛生法
q_zh: 為提升雇主及工作者之職業安全衛生知識並促進安全衛生文化之發展，中央主管機關得採取何種作為？
a_zh: 得逕行編列預算補助各事業單位，並免除其當年度受檢查義務
b_zh: 得命各級學校將職業安全衛生列為必修學分並辦理統一之考試
c_zh: 得訂定獎勵或補助辦法，鼓勵事業單位及有關團體辦理相關活動
d_zh: 得指定民間團體強制辦理宣導，其所需費用由事業單位分攤之
q_en: How may the central authority promote safety and health knowledge and culture?
a_en: By directly budgeting subsidies for every enterprise and exempting them from inspection that year
b_en: By ordering all schools to make occupational safety a required credit with a uniform examination
c_en: By setting rules on incentives or subsidies to encourage enterprises and related groups to act
d_en: By designating private groups to run compulsory campaigns funded by levies on the enterprises
explain_zh: 第50條第1項：中央主管機關得訂定獎勵或補助辦法，鼓勵事業單位及有關團體辦理。第2項並定直轄市與縣（市）主管機關及各目的事業主管機關應積極推動職業安全衛生業務，中央主管機關得訂定績效評核及獎勵辦法。其應辦理之業務項目詳見施行細則第53條。
explain_en: Article 50, Paragraph 1.

law: 職業安全衛生法
q_zh: 自營作業者獨立作業或以其作業交付承攬時，依本法規定應適用哪些條文？
a_zh: 全部條文均適用，僅第二十條體格檢查及在職勞工健康檢查之規定除外，其餘規定均應完全遵守辦理
b_zh: 適用第八條至第十一條、第十五條、第十七條、第二十一條、第二十九條、第三十一條、第三十八條及其罰則
c_zh: 適用第五條至第七條、第十二條、第十八條、第二十條、第二十三條、第三十二條、第三十七條及其罰則
d_zh: 適用第五條至第七條、第九條、第十條、第十四條、第十六條、第二十四條、第二十六條至第二十八條及其罰則
q_en: Which provisions apply to a self-employed worker working alone or contracting out the work?
a_en: All provisions apply except the Article 20 physical and in-service health examination rules
b_en: Articles 8 to 11, 15, 17, 21, 29, 31 and 38, together with the corresponding penalty provisions
c_en: Articles 5 to 7, 12, 18, 20, 23, 32 and 37, together with the corresponding penalty provisions
d_en: Articles 5 to 7, 9, 10, 14, 16, 24, and 26 to 28, together with their penalty provisions
explain_zh: 第51條第1項：自營作業者獨立作業或以其作業交付承攬時，適用第5條至第7條、第9條、第10條、第14條、第16條、第24條、第26條、第27條、第28條及其罰則規定。施行細則第2條並定自營作業者指獨立從事勞動或技藝工作，獲致報酬，且未僱用有酬人員幫同工作者。
explain_en: Article 51, Paragraph 1.

law: 職業安全衛生法
q_zh: 受工作場所負責人指揮或監督從事勞動之人員，於事業單位工作場所從事勞動時，本法之適用情形為何？
a_zh: 須與該事業單位另訂書面契約後，始得比照其勞工適用本法之全部規定
b_zh: 比照該事業單位之勞工適用本法，但第六條所定安全衛生設備及措施之規定不在此限
c_zh: 僅於從事危險性機械設備操作時，始比照該事業單位之勞工適用本法
d_zh: 比照該事業單位之勞工適用本法，但第二十條體格檢查及在職勞工健康檢查之規定不在此限
q_en: How does the Act apply to persons working under the direction of the workplace supervisor?
a_en: A separate written contract with the enterprise is needed before the Act can apply to them
b_en: They are treated as the workplaces own workers, except for the Article 6 equipment and measures
c_en: The Act applies to them only while they operate dangerous machinery or dangerous equipment
d_en: They are treated as the workplaces own workers, except for Article 20 physical and health checks
explain_zh: 第51條第2項：第2條第1款所定受工作場所負責人指揮或監督從事勞動之人員，於事業單位工作場所從事勞動，比照該事業單位之勞工，適用本法之規定；但第20條之體格檢查及在職勞工健康檢查之規定，不在此限。施行細則第2條第2項定此類人員指與事業單位無僱傭關係，於其工作場所從事勞動或以學習技能、接受職業訓練為目的從事勞動之工作者。
explain_en: Article 51, Paragraph 2.

law: 職業安全衛生法
q_zh: 事業單位以數位方式經營商品交易或運送，且交付無僱傭關係之個人親自履行外送作業時，適用本法哪些規定？
a_zh: 適用第五條第二項、第八條、第二十條第一項、第二十三條、第三十八條第一項及其罰則規定
b_zh: 適用第七條至第九條、第十四條、第三十一條、第三十四條第一項及其罰則規定
c_zh: 適用第五條第一項、第六條、第三十二條第一項、第三十三條、第三十七條第二項及其罰則規定
d_zh: 適用第六條第二項、第十六條、第二十六條、第二十七條、第三十九條第一項及其罰則規定
q_en: Which provisions apply when a platform hands delivery work to individuals with no employment relationship?
a_en: Articles 5-2, 8, 20-1, 23 and 38-1, together with their corresponding penalty provisions
b_en: Articles 7 to 9, 14, 31 and 34-1, together with their corresponding penalty provisions
c_en: Articles 5-1, 6, 32-1, 33 and 37-2, together with their corresponding penalty provisions
d_en: Articles 6-2, 16, 26, 27 and 39-1, together with their corresponding penalty provisions
explain_zh: 第51條之1：事業單位以數位方式經營商品交易或運送，且交付無僱傭關係之個人親自履行外送作業時，適用第5條第1項（合理可行範圍內防止危害）、第6條（安全衛生設備及措施）、第32條第1項（安全衛生教育訓練）、第33條（宣導）、第37條第2項（職業災害通報）及其罰則規定。
explain_en: Article 51-1.

law: 職業安全衛生法
q_zh: 中央主管機關依本法規定，得將下列何種業務委託相關專業團體辦理？
a_zh: 第十八條工作者退避權之認定、第二十二條勞工健康服務之實施、第三十四條工作守則之核備等業務
b_zh: 第二十六條承攬告知之查核、第二十七條共同作業協議組織之召集、第三十七條災害通報之受理等
c_zh: 第四十條至第四十五條罰鍰之裁處、第四十九條違規名單之公布、第五十三條規費之收取等業務
d_zh: 第八條驗證機構管理、第十二條作業環境監測機構管理與監測結果通報、第三十九條第二項疑似職業病調查等
q_en: Which duties may the central authority entrust to professional bodies?
a_en: Article 18 retreat rights, Article 22 health services delivery, Article 34 approval of work rules
b_en: Article 26 contracting notice audits, Article 27 coordination bodies, Article 37 disaster reporting
c_en: Articles 40 to 45 fines, Article 49 publication of violators, Article 53 collection of the fees
d_en: Article 8 verification bodies, Article 12 monitoring bodies and reporting, Article 39-2 disease surveys
explain_zh: 第52條：中央主管機關得將第8條驗證機構管理、第9條抽驗與市場查驗、第12條作業環境監測機構之管理與監測結果之通報、第13條新化學物質之登記與報告審查、第14條管制性化學品許可與優先管理化學品運作資料備查、第20條認可醫療機構管理及健檢結果通報、第23條第3項管理系統訪查與績效認可、第32條第2項訓練單位管理及第39條第2項疑似職業病調查等業務，委託相關專業團體辦理。
explain_en: Article 52.

law: 職業安全衛生法
q_zh: 主管機關辦理本法所定之認可、審查、許可、驗證、檢查及指定等業務時，關於費用之規定為何？
a_zh: 得視業務性質決定是否收費，其收費標準由各直轄市主管機關公告之
b_zh: 一律免收規費，所需經費由中央主管機關編列年度預算支應辦理
c_zh: 應收取規費，其收費標準由行政院會商各目的事業主管機關定之
d_zh: 應收取規費，其收費標準由中央主管機關定之，不得由各檢查機構自行訂定
q_en: What does the Act provide about fees for accreditation, review, permits, verification and inspection?
a_en: Whether to charge is discretionary, and each municipal authority announces its own schedule
b_en: No fees are charged at all; the costs are met from the central authoritys annual budget
c_en: Fees must be charged, and the schedule is set by the Executive Yuan with the line ministries
d_en: Fees must be charged, and the schedule is set by the central competent authority alone
explain_zh: 第53條：主管機關辦理本法所定之認可、審查、許可、驗證、檢查及指定等業務，應收規費；其收費標準由中央主管機關定之。此與第52條得委託專業團體辦理相關業務之規定並行；受託團體辦理之業務仍屬本條規費之範圍。
explain_en: Article 53.

law: 職業安全衛生法
q_zh: 職業安全衛生法施行細則之訂定機關為何？
a_zh: 由各直轄市主管機關分別訂定，並報請中央主管機關核定發布
b_zh: 由行政院訂定，並送立法院查照後發布施行，以昭公信及明確
c_zh: 由中央主管機關訂定，即由勞動部依本法第五十四條之授權訂定發布
d_zh: 由中央主管機關會同各目的事業主管機關共同會銜訂定並發布
q_en: Which authority issues the Enforcement Rules of the Act?
a_en: Each municipal competent authority separately, subject to approval by the central authority
b_en: The Executive Yuan, which then files them with the Legislative Yuan before promulgation
c_en: The central competent authority, that is the Ministry of Labor, under Article 54 of the Act
d_en: The central authority jointly with all the relevant line ministries under a joint signature
explain_zh: 第54條：本法施行細則，由中央主管機關定之。依第3條規定，中央主管機關為勞動部。現行職業安全衛生法施行細則第1條即載明本細則依本法第54條規定訂定之。至本法之施行日期則依第55條由行政院定之。
explain_en: Article 54; see also Article 1 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法
q_zh: 職業安全衛生法之施行日期如何決定？
a_zh: 由行政院定之，而非採自公布日施行或公布後特定日數施行之方式
b_zh: 由中央主管機關定之，並報請行政院備查後公告施行日期
c_zh: 自公布後一年施行，但經立法院決議者得提前其施行日期
d_zh: 自公布日施行，其歷次修正條文則一律自公布後六個月施行
q_en: How is the effective date of the Act determined?
a_en: It is fixed by the Executive Yuan, not by promulgation or a set number of days after it
b_en: It is fixed by the central authority and announced after filing with the Executive Yuan
c_en: It takes effect one year after promulgation, but may be advanced by legislative vote
d_en: It takes effect on promulgation, and every amendment takes effect six months later
explain_zh: 第55條：本法施行日期，由行政院定之。此與第54條施行細則由中央主管機關訂定不同。施行細則第54條則定該細則自中華民國一百零三年七月三日施行，並就一百零九年及一百十五年之修正條文分別定其施行日期。
explain_en: Article 55.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 職業安全衛生法施行細則之訂定依據為何？
a_zh: 依職業安全衛生法第五條第二項規定訂定，屬地方自治法規之一種類型
b_zh: 依勞動檢查法第三十九條規定訂定，並由各勞動檢查機構負責統一解釋
c_zh: 依職業安全衛生法第五十四條規定訂定，屬中央主管機關發布之法規命令
d_zh: 依職業安全衛生法第六條第三項規定訂定，其法律位階等同於法律本身
q_en: Under which provision are the Enforcement Rules of the OSH Act issued?
a_en: Under Article 5-2 of the OSH Act, taking the form of a local self-government regulation
b_en: Under Article 39 of the Labor Inspection Act, interpreted by the inspection agencies
c_en: Under Article 54 of the OSH Act, as a regulation issued by the central competent authority
d_en: Under Article 6-3 of the OSH Act, ranking equal in status to the statute itself
explain_zh: 第1條：本細則依職業安全衛生法（以下簡稱本法）第54條規定訂定之。本法第54條授權中央主管機關訂定施行細則，中央主管機關依本法第3條為勞動部。至本法第6條第3項所授權訂定者則為職業安全衛生設施規則等安全衛生設備及措施之規則。
explain_en: Article 1 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 施行細則所稱「自營作業者」，指下列何者？
a_zh: 與事業單位訂有僱傭契約，受其指揮監督而獲致報酬之受僱工作者
b_zh: 僱用五人以下有酬人員幫同工作，並因而獲致報酬之小型企業經營者
c_zh: 獨立從事勞動或技藝工作，獲致報酬，且未僱用有酬人員幫同工作者
d_zh: 受公司委任處理事務，並持有公司股份而參與盈餘分配之出資股東
q_en: Under the Enforcement Rules, a 'self-employed person' means:
a_en: A worker under an employment contract who works for remuneration under the enterprise's direction
b_en: A small business operator who obtains remuneration and employs five or fewer paid helpers
c_en: A person who independently performs labor or craft work for remuneration without employing paid helpers
d_en: A shareholder who is commissioned to handle company affairs and shares in its profits
explain_zh: 施行細則第2條第1項：自營作業者，指獨立從事勞動或技藝工作，獲致報酬，且未僱用有酬人員幫同工作者。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 2(1): a self-employed person independently performs labor or craft work for remuneration and does not employ paid personnel to assist.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 施行細則所稱「工作場所負責人」，指下列何者？
a_zh: 由工會會員大會選舉產生，代表全體會員對外行使職權之工會理事長
b_zh: 由中央主管機關指派，於該工作場所執行檢查及調查職務之勞動檢查員
c_zh: 受雇主委託辦理該工作場所建築設計及施工監造業務之開業建築師
d_zh: 雇主或於該工作場所代表雇主從事管理、指揮或監督工作者從事勞動之人
q_en: Under the Enforcement Rules, the 'workplace manager' means:
a_en: The union chairperson elected by the members' assembly to exercise authority for all members
b_en: A labor inspector assigned by the central competent authority to carry out inspections at that workplace
c_en: A licensed architect commissioned by the employer to design and supervise construction at that workplace
d_en: The employer, or a person representing the employer at the workplace to manage, direct or supervise workers
explain_zh: 施行細則第3條：工作場所負責人，指雇主或於該工作場所代表雇主從事管理、指揮或監督工作者從事勞動之人。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 3: the workplace manager is the employer or a person who represents the employer at the workplace to manage, direct or supervise workers performing labor.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 施行細則所稱「工資」是否包括獎金、津貼等經常性給與？
a_zh: 僅包括以現金給付之部分，實物或代金形式之給與均不計入
b_zh: 僅包括延長工時之加班費及假日出勤加給，其餘均不計入
c_zh: 包括，凡因工作獲得之報酬及任何名義之經常性給與均屬之
d_zh: 不包括，僅限勞動契約約定按月給付之本薪，其餘均不計入
q_en: Under the Enforcement Rules, does 'wage' include bonuses, allowances and other regular payments?
a_en: Only payments made in cash count; payments in kind or in goods are excluded
b_en: Only overtime pay for extended hours and holiday work premiums are included
c_en: Yes, all remuneration for work and regular payments under any name are included
d_en: No, only the base salary agreed in the labor contract and paid monthly counts
explain_zh: 施行細則第4條：工資指勞工因工作而獲得之報酬，包括工資、薪金及按計時、計日、計月、計件以現金或實物等方式給付之獎金、津貼及其他任何名義之經常性給與均屬之。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 4: wage means remuneration obtained for work, including wages, salaries, and bonuses, allowances and other regular payments under any name paid in cash or in kind.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 職業安全衛生法施行細則第五條之現行狀態為何？
a_zh: 該條業經刪除而無規範內容；自營作業者之定義現規定於本細則第二條
b_zh: 該條仍屬有效，規定事業單位應設職業安全衛生委員會之勞工人數門檻
c_zh: 該條業經刪除，惟其原定之危害性化學品分類標準仍應繼續適用至今
d_zh: 該條仍屬有效，規定勞工健康服務醫師及護理人員之資格與配置人數
q_en: What is the current status of Article 5 of the Enforcement Rules?
a_en: It has been deleted and has no content; self-employed workers are defined in Article 2
b_en: It remains in force and sets the worker headcount for a safety and health committee
c_en: It has been deleted, but its chemical classification standard still applies for now
d_en: It remains in force and sets the qualifications and numbers of occupational health staff
explain_zh: 第5條：（刪除）。現行條文並無規範內容。與自營作業者有關之定義規定於第2條第1項，指獨立從事勞動或技藝工作，獲致報酬，且未僱用有酬人員幫同工作者；工作場所負責人之定義則規定於第3條。
explain_en: Article 5 was deleted; see Article 2 for the definition.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第二條第五款職業災害定義中所稱之職業上原因，其意義為何？
a_zh: 指經職業醫學科專科醫師診斷，並經勞動檢查機構認定與作業有關之原因
b_zh: 指隨作業活動所衍生，於勞動上一切必要行為及其附隨行為而具有相當因果關係者
c_zh: 指勞動場所之建築物、機械、設備、原料等物項本身所具有之固有危害
d_zh: 指勞工在雇主指定之工作時間內所為之行為，不包括通勤及用餐等附隨行為
q_en: What are occupational causes under Article 2, Subparagraph 5 of the Act?
a_en: Causes diagnosed by an occupational medicine specialist and confirmed by an inspection agency
b_en: Acts necessary to labor and their incidental acts arising from work, with adequate causation
c_en: Hazards inherent in the buildings, machinery, equipment and raw materials at the workplace
d_en: Acts done within the working hours set by the employer, excluding commuting and meal breaks
explain_zh: 第6條：本法第2條第5款所稱職業上原因，指隨作業活動所衍生，於勞動上一切必要行為及其附隨行為而具有相當因果關係者。本法第2條第5款之職業災害，係指因勞動場所之建築物、機械、設備、原料、材料、化學品、氣體、蒸氣、粉塵等或作業活動及其他職業上原因引起之工作者疾病、傷害、失能或死亡。
explain_en: Article 6 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第四條所稱各業，其適用範圍如何認定？
a_zh: 以經濟部工廠登記之營業項目為準，未辦登記者不在適用範圍
b_zh: 適用中華民國行業標準分類之規定，本法原則上適用於各業
c_zh: 由中央主管機關逐年公告指定適用之行業，未公告者不適用
d_zh: 以事業單位向勞工保險機構申報之投保行業別作為認定依據
q_en: How is the scope of all industries under Article 4 of the Act determined?
a_en: By the business items in the factory registration; unregistered businesses fall outside the scope
b_en: By the Standard Industrial Classification of the Republic of China; the Act covers all industries
c_en: By an annual list of industries announced by the central authority; unlisted ones are excluded
d_en: By the industry category declared by the enterprise to the labor insurance administering body
explain_zh: 第7條：本法第4條所稱各業，適用中華民國行業標準分類之規定。本法第4條規定本法適用於各業，但因事業規模、性質及風險特性，得由中央主管機關指定公告其適用本法之部分規定。
explain_en: Article 7 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 施行細則所稱「風險評估」，指下列何種程序？
a_zh: 編列、審查及執行預算之程序
b_zh: 評估、投保及理賠保險之程序
c_zh: 公告、招標及決標作業之程序
d_zh: 辨識、分析及評量風險之程序
q_en: Under the Enforcement Rules, 'risk assessment' means the process of:
a_en: Compiling, reviewing and executing budgets
b_en: Assessing, purchasing and claiming insurance
c_en: Announcing, tendering and awarding contracts
d_en: Identifying, analyzing and evaluating risks
explain_zh: 施行細則第8條第2項：本法第五條第二項及第二十六條第一項所稱風險評估，指辨識、分析及評量風險之程序。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 8(2): risk assessment means the process of identifying, analyzing and evaluating risks.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 施行細則對本法第5條「合理可行範圍」之定義，其判斷依據不包括下列何者？
a_zh: 指引、實務規範
b_zh: 本法及有關安全衛生法令
c_zh: 雇主之營運成本高低
d_zh: 一般社會通念
q_en: Which of the following is NOT a basis for judging the 'reasonably practicable scope' under the Enforcement Rules?
a_en: Guidelines and codes of practice
b_en: The Act and related safety and health laws
c_en: The employer's operating cost
d_en: General social norms
explain_zh: 施行細則第8條第1項：合理可行範圍，指依本法及有關安全衛生法令、指引、實務規範或一般社會通念，雇主明知或可得而知勞工所從事之工作有致其生命、身體及健康受危害之虞，並可採取必要之預防設備或措施者。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 8(1): the scope is judged by the Act, related laws, guidelines, codes of practice or general social norms, where the employer knew or could have known of hazards and could take preventive measures.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本細則第九條目前之規範內容為何？
a_zh: 該條仍屬有效，規定中央主管機關指定之機械設備應辦理型式驗證
b_zh: 該條仍屬有效，規定雇主應每年實施風險評估一次並作成書面紀錄
c_zh: 該條業經刪除而無內容；合理可行範圍及風險評估之定義規定於第八條
d_zh: 該條業經刪除，惟原條文有關安全衛生指引之規定仍得作為裁罰依據
q_en: What does Article 9 of the Enforcement Rules now provide?
a_en: It remains in force and requires type verification for machinery designated by the ministry
b_en: It remains in force and requires employers to run a risk assessment yearly and record it
c_en: It has been deleted with no content; reasonably practicable and risk assessment are in Article 8
d_en: It has been deleted, yet its wording on safety guidelines may still support a penalty
explain_zh: 第9條：（刪除）。現行條文並無內容。本法第5條第1項所稱合理可行範圍及第5條第2項、第26條第1項所稱風險評估之定義，規定於本細則第8條；風險評估指辨識、分析及評量風險之程序。
explain_en: Article 9 was deleted; see Article 8.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本細則第十條之現行效力為何？
a_zh: 仍屬有效，規定型式驗證之申請程序、審驗方式及驗證合格標章之使用
b_zh: 業經刪除而無規範內容；中央主管機關指定之機械設備器具種類規定於第十二條
c_zh: 業經刪除，惟原條文所定之機械器具安全防護標準仍應由雇主優先適用
d_zh: 仍屬有效，規定雇主對於防爆電氣設備應於使用前實施重點檢查並作紀錄
q_en: What is the current effect of Article 10 of the Enforcement Rules?
a_en: Still in force, setting the application, review and marking procedure for type verification
b_en: Deleted with no content; the designated machinery and equipment are listed in Article 12
c_en: Deleted, yet its safety guarding standards for machinery still take priority for employers
d_en: Still in force, requiring a key inspection of explosion-proof electrical gear before use
explain_zh: 第10條：（刪除）。本法第7條第1項所稱中央主管機關指定之機械、設備或器具，規定於本細則第12條，共列動力衝剪機械、手推刨床、木材加工用圓盤鋸、動力堆高機、研磨機、研磨輪、防爆電氣設備等十一款。型式驗證之定義則見第13條。
explain_en: Article 10 was deleted; see Article 12.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
category: 職安細則-不法侵害預防
q_zh: 對於執行職務因他人行為遭受身體或精神不法侵害之預防，本細則對雇主之要求及責任認定機關為何？
a_zh: 雇主應依相關法令採取必要安全衛生措施，包括辦理內部調查及一定處置；涉及民刑事或行政責任者，由各該主管機關或司法機關調查認定
b_zh: 雇主僅須提供受害勞工心理諮商及轉介服務；涉及民刑事或行政責任者，由事業單位之職業安全衛生委員會決議並作成認定
c_zh: 雇主應將加害人立即調離現場並終止其勞動契約；涉及民刑事或行政責任者，由中央主管機關統一調查並作成最終之認定
d_zh: 雇主應於事件發生後三日內報請勞動檢查機構調查；涉及民事或刑事責任者，一律先由勞動檢查機構移送司法機關偵辦並認定
q_en: What must employers do to prevent unlawful physical or mental harm by others during work, and who decides liability?
a_en: Take needed measures under the law, including an internal inquiry and disposition; agencies or courts decide liability
b_en: Only provide counselling and referral for the victim; the enterprise safety committee resolves liability
c_en: Remove and dismiss the offender at once; the central authority alone investigates and decides liability
d_en: Report to the inspection agency within three days; the inspection agency refers the case for prosecution first
explain_zh: 第11條：本法第6條第2項第3款所定執行職務因他人行為遭受身體或精神不法侵害之預防，雇主應依相關法令規定採取必要之安全衛生措施，包括辦理內部調查及為一定之處置；其涉及民事、刑事或行政責任者，由各該主管機關或司法機關依規定調查或認定。本法第6條第2項並要求雇主就此訂定計畫及採取必要之安全衛生措施。
explain_en: Article 11 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 下列何者不是施行細則第12條所列本法第7條指定之機械、設備或器具？
a_zh: 動力堆高機
b_zh: 防爆電氣設備
c_zh: 研磨機
d_zh: 固定式起重機
q_en: Which of the following is NOT a designated machine, equipment or tool under Enforcement Rules Article 12 (Article 7 of the Act)?
a_en: Powered forklift
b_en: Explosion-proof electrical equipment
c_en: Grinder
d_en: Fixed crane
explain_zh: 施行細則第12條列舉：動力衝剪機械、手推刨床、木材加工用圓盤鋸、動力堆高機、研磨機、研磨輪、防爆電氣設備及相關安全裝置等。固定式起重機屬第22條之危險性機械。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 12 lists power shearing/punching machines, hand-fed planers, woodworking circular saws, powered forklifts, grinders, grinding wheels, explosion-proof electrical equipment and related safety devices. A fixed crane is dangerous machinery under Article 22.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第七條至第九條所稱之型式驗證，其定義為何？
a_zh: 指由驗證機構對某一型式之機械、設備或器具等產品，審驗符合安全標準之程序
b_zh: 指由勞動檢查機構對個別出廠產品逐台檢查，確認其符合國家標準之程序
c_zh: 指由製造者自行檢測後向中央主管機關報備，並取得核可文件之作業程序
d_zh: 指由代行檢查機構對危險性機械設備實施構造檢查及竣工檢查之程序
q_en: What is type verification under Articles 7 to 9 of the Act?
a_en: A procedure by which a verification body examines a product type for conformity with safety standards
b_en: A procedure by which the inspection agency checks each unit leaving the factory against a standard
c_en: A procedure by which the maker tests the product itself and files it with the ministry for approval
d_en: A procedure by which an accredited agency runs construction and completion checks on equipment
explain_zh: 第13條：本法第7條至第9條所稱型式驗證，指由驗證機構對某一型式之機械、設備或器具等產品，審驗符合安全標準之程序。本法第7條規定製造者、輸入者、供應者或雇主對於中央主管機關指定之機械、設備或器具，其構造、性能及防護非符合安全標準者，不得產製運出廠場、輸入、租賃、供應或設置。
explain_en: Article 13 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 施行細則第14條所稱危害性化學品，其「危險物」與「有害物」之區分依據為何？
a_zh: 依CNS15030分類，具物理性危害者為危險物、具健康危害者為有害物
b_zh: 依製造產地來源分類，國外進口者為危險物、國內生產者為有害物
c_zh: 依市場售價高低分類，價格昂貴者為危險物、價格低廉者為有害物
d_zh: 依包裝容量大小分類，容量較大者為危險物、容量較小者為有害物
q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 14, how are 'dangerous substances' and 'harmful substances' distinguished?
a_en: By CNS 15030 classification: physical hazards are dangerous substances; health hazards are harmful substances
b_en: By country of origin: imported chemicals are dangerous substances; domestic ones are harmful substances
c_en: By market price: expensive chemicals are dangerous substances; low-priced ones are harmful substances
d_en: By package volume: larger containers hold dangerous substances; smaller ones hold harmful substances
explain_zh: 施行細則第14條：危險物指符合國家標準CNS15030分類，具有物理性危害者；有害物指符合CNS15030分類，具有健康危害者。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 14: dangerous substances have physical hazards and harmful substances have health hazards, both classified under national standard CNS 15030.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第十條第一項所稱危害性化學品之清單，其應記載之項目為何？
a_zh: 記載勞工暴露濃度、作業環境監測結果及健康檢查結果等項目
b_zh: 記載化學品名稱、製造商或供應商基本資料、使用及貯存量等項目之清冊或表單
c_zh: 記載化學品之運作量、危害分類、標示圖式及物理化學特性等項目
d_zh: 記載化學品名稱、危害特性、緊急處理及危害預防措施等項目之表單
q_en: What items must the list of hazardous chemicals under Article 10-1 of the Act contain?
a_en: Worker exposure levels, workplace monitoring results and health examination outcomes
b_en: Chemical names, basic data of the maker or supplier, and the amounts used and stored
c_en: The handling volume, hazard classification, labelling pictograms and physical properties
d_en: Chemical names, hazard properties, emergency handling and hazard prevention measures
explain_zh: 第15條：本法第10條第1項所稱危害性化學品之清單，指記載化學品名稱、製造商或供應商基本資料、使用及貯存量等項目之清冊或表單。應與第16條之安全資料表區別，安全資料表係記載化學品名稱、製造商或供應商基本資料、危害特性、緊急處理及危害預防措施等項目之表單。
explain_en: Article 15; contrast the safety data sheet in Article 16.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 施行細則所稱危害性化學品之「安全資料表」，應記載下列何種項目？
a_zh: 採購人員姓名、所屬部門、聯絡電話、請購單編號及核准主管職稱
b_zh: 化學品名稱、製造商或供應商基本資料、危害特性、緊急處理及危害預防措施
c_zh: 化學品售價、經銷商折扣方案、付款條件、交貨期限及退貨處理方式
d_zh: 運送車輛車牌號碼、駕駛人姓名、行車路線、里程數及運費計算方式
q_en: Under the Enforcement Rules, a chemical 'safety data sheet' shall record:
a_en: Purchaser's name, department, contact telephone number, requisition form number and the approving supervisor's title
b_en: Chemical name, manufacturer/supplier information, hazard characteristics, emergency handling and hazard prevention measures
c_en: Selling price, distributor discount schemes, payment terms, delivery deadlines and procedures for handling returns
d_en: Delivery vehicle plate number, driver's name, transport route, mileage and the method for calculating freight charges
explain_zh: 施行細則第16條：安全資料表指記載化學品名稱、製造商或供應商基本資料、危害特性、緊急處理及危害預防措施等項目之表單。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 16: the safety data sheet records the chemical name, manufacturer or supplier information, hazard characteristics, emergency handling and hazard prevention measures.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 施行細則第17條所稱「作業環境監測」，包含下列何種程序？
a_zh: 招募、甄選、訓練、考核及晉升
b_zh: 設計、發包、施工、監造及驗收
c_zh: 採購、詢價、驗收、入庫及領用
d_zh: 規劃、採樣、測定、分析及評估
q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 17, 'workplace environment monitoring' includes which procedures?
a_en: Recruitment, selection, training, appraisal and promotion
b_en: Design, tendering, construction, supervision and acceptance
c_en: Procurement, quotation, acceptance, storage and issuing
d_en: Planning, sampling, measurement, analysis and evaluation
explain_zh: 施行細則第17條第1項：作業環境監測，指為掌握勞工作業環境實態與評估勞工暴露狀況，所採取之規劃、採樣、測定、分析及評估。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 17(1): workplace environment monitoring means planning, sampling, measurement, analysis and evaluation to grasp the actual workplace environment and assess laborers' exposure.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 下列何者屬施行細則第17條第2項應訂定作業環境監測計畫並實施監測之作業場所？
a_zh: 露天無遮蔽之戶外停車場
b_zh: 一般開放式辦公室場所
c_zh: 公司一樓接待大廳區域
d_zh: 顯著發生噪音之作業場所
q_en: Which of the following is an operation site requiring a monitoring plan and monitoring under Enforcement Rules Article 17(2)?
a_en: An unsheltered outdoor parking lot
b_en: A general open-plan office work area
c_en: The reception lobby on the first floor
d_en: An operation site with significant noise
explain_zh: 施行細則第17條第2項：設置中央管理方式空氣調節設備之建築物室內作業場所、坑內作業場所、顯著發生噪音之作業場所、經指定之高溫/粉塵/鉛/四烷基鉛/有機溶劑/特定化學物質作業場所、其他指定公告之作業場所。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 17(2): indoor sites with central air-conditioning, underground sites, sites with significant noise, designated high-temperature/dust/lead/tetraalkyl lead/organic solvent/specified chemical sites, and other designated sites.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 施行細則第17條第2項第4款經中央主管機關指定之作業場所，不包括下列何者？
a_zh: 有機溶劑作業場所
b_zh: 高溫作業場所
c_zh: 一般倉儲作業場所
d_zh: 粉塵作業場所
q_en: Which of the following is NOT among the designated operation sites in Enforcement Rules Article 17(2)(4)?
a_en: Organic solvent operation sites
b_en: High-temperature operation sites
c_en: General warehousing sites
d_en: Dust operation sites
explain_zh: 施行細則第17條第2項第4款列六類：高溫作業場所、粉塵作業場所、鉛作業場所、四烷基鉛作業場所、有機溶劑作業場所、特定化學物質作業場所。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 17(2)(4) lists six categories: high-temperature, dust, lead, tetraalkyl lead, organic solvent and specified chemical substance operation sites.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 中央主管機關審查化學物質安全評估報告後，得予公開之資訊包括下列何者？
a_zh: 製造者之營業秘密、產品配方比例、供應商名單及其產品銷售價格等資訊
b_zh: 勞工之暴露評估結果、作業環境監測紀錄及特殊健康檢查之個別結果等
c_zh: 新化學物質之名稱、製造或輸入之數量、於混合物之組成及其製造用途等資訊
d_zh: 新化學物質編碼、危害分類及標示、物理及化學特性資訊、毒理資訊、安全使用資訊等
q_en: Which information may be disclosed after review of a chemical safety assessment report?
a_en: The makers trade secrets, formulation ratios, supplier lists and the selling prices of products
b_en: Worker exposure assessments, workplace monitoring records and individual health check results
c_en: The name of the new substance, the volume made or imported, its share in mixtures and its uses
d_en: The new substance code, hazard classification and labelling, physical, toxicological and use data
explain_zh: 第18條第1項：得予公開之資訊為新化學物質編碼、危害分類及標示、物理及化學特性資訊、毒理資訊、安全使用資訊，以及為因應緊急措施或維護工作者安全健康有必要揭露予特定人員之資訊。第2項則定第1項第6款之資訊範圍包括新化學物質名稱及基本辨識資訊、製造或輸入數量、於混合物之組成及製造用途與暴露資訊。
explain_en: Article 18, Paragraph 1; Paragraph 2 covers disclosure to specified persons.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 施行細則第19條所定「管制性化學品」，其分類依據為何？
a_zh: 優先管理化學品中屬皮膚腐蝕性第一級、嚴重眼損傷第一級或吸入性危害第一級，且採購單價昂貴須報備者
b_zh: 優先管理化學品中屬致癌物質第一級、生殖細胞致突變性物質第一級或生殖毒性物質第一級，且經評估具高度暴露風險者
c_zh: 優先管理化學品中屬爆炸物第一級、自反應物質第一級或有機過氧化物第一級，且儲存量達五百公斤以上者
d_zh: 所有核准輸入化學品中屬易燃液體第一級、氧化性固體第一級或急毒性物質第一級，且年輸入量達一公噸者
q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 19, 'controlled chemicals' are classified as:
a_en: Priority management chemicals that are Category 1 skin corrosives, Category 1 serious eye damage agents or Category 1 aspiration hazards under CNS 15030 with a high unit purchase price
b_en: Priority management chemicals that are Category 1 carcinogens, Category 1 germ cell mutagens or Category 1 reproductive toxicants under CNS 15030 and assessed as high exposure risk
c_en: Priority management chemicals that are Category 1 explosives, Category 1 self-reactive substances or Category 1 organic peroxides under CNS 15030 stored in quantities of 500 kg or more
d_en: All approved imported chemicals that are Category 1 flammable liquids, Category 1 oxidizing solids or Category 1 acutely toxic substances imported at one tonne or more a year
explain_zh: 施行細則第19條：管制性化學品指第20條所定優先管理化學品中，依CNS15030分類屬致癌物質第一級、生殖細胞致突變性物質第一級或生殖毒性物質第一級，且經中央主管機關評估具高度暴露風險者，及其他經指定公告者。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 19: controlled chemicals are priority management chemicals classified under CNS 15030 as Category 1 carcinogens, germ cell mutagens or reproductive toxicants and assessed by the central competent authority as high exposure risk, plus other designated chemicals.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 下列何者屬於本法第十四條第二項所稱之優先管理化學品？
a_zh: 依國家標準CNS 15030分類，屬致癌物質第一級、生殖細胞致突變性物質第一級或生殖毒性物質第一級者
b_zh: 經中央主管機關評估具高度暴露風險，且已依本法第十四條第一項規定取得許可者
c_zh: 經作業環境監測結果超過容許暴露標準二分之一，且該場所勞工人數達一百人以上者
d_zh: 依國家標準CNS 15030分類，屬致癌物質第二級、皮膚腐蝕性物質第一級或呼吸道過敏物質者
q_en: Which chemicals count as priority management chemicals under Article 14-2 of the Act?
a_en: Those classified under CNS 15030 as category 1 carcinogens, mutagens or reproductive toxicants
b_en: Those assessed by the central authority as high exposure risk and already permitted under Article 14-1
c_en: Those whose monitoring results exceed half the permissible limit at a site with 100 or more workers
d_en: Those classified under CNS 15030 as category 2 carcinogens, skin corrosives or respiratory sensitisers
explain_zh: 第20條：優先管理化學品包括本法第29條第1項第3款及第30條第1項第5款所列之危害性化學品；依CNS 15030分類屬致癌物質第一級、生殖細胞致突變性物質第一級或生殖毒性物質第一級者；依CNS 15030分類具物理性危害或健康危害且運作量達中央主管機關規定者；及其他經中央主管機關指定公告者。第19條之管制性化學品則另須經評估具高度暴露風險。
explain_en: Article 20; compare Article 19 on controlled chemicals.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第十五條第一項第一款所稱從事石油裂解之石化工業，應如何界定？
a_zh: 指從事石油之開採、精煉或輸儲，並附設高壓氣體類壓力容器之工作場所者
b_zh: 指使用異氰酸甲酯、氯化氫、氨或吡啶為原料，從事化學品合成之工作場所
c_zh: 指勞動檢查法第二十六條第一項第一款所定從事石油產品之裂解反應，以製造石化基本原料者
d_zh: 指依工廠管理輔導法登記為石油化學材料製造業，且其勞工人數在一百人以上者
q_en: How is the petrochemical industry engaged in petroleum cracking under Article 15-1-1 defined?
a_en: As extraction, refining or storage of petroleum with a high pressure gas vessel installed on site
b_en: As synthesis of chemicals using methyl isocyanate, hydrogen chloride, ammonia or pyridine feed
c_en: As in Article 26-1-1 of the Labor Inspection Act: cracking petroleum products to make basic feedstock
d_en: As a firm registered as a petrochemical materials maker with one hundred or more workers on site
explain_zh: 第21條第1項：本法第15條第1項第1款所稱從事石油裂解之石化工業，指勞動檢查法第26條第1項第1款所定從事石油產品之裂解反應，以製造石化基本原料者。第2項並定第15條第1項第2款危害性化學品數量達規定量者，指勞動檢查法第26條第1項第5款所定製造、處置或使用危險物及有害物達中央主管機關規定之數量。
explain_en: Article 21 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 下列何者不屬施行細則第22條所列具有危險性之機械？
a_zh: 營建用升降機
b_zh: 固定式起重機
c_zh: 移動式起重機
d_zh: 動力堆高機
q_en: Which of the following is NOT dangerous machinery under Enforcement Rules Article 22?
a_en: Construction elevator
b_en: Fixed crane
c_en: Mobile crane
d_en: Powered forklift
explain_zh: 施行細則第22條：危險性機械指一定容量以上之固定式起重機、移動式起重機、人字臂起重桿、營建用升降機、營建用提升機、吊籠及其他指定公告者。動力堆高機屬第12條指定機械。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 22: dangerous machinery includes fixed cranes, mobile cranes, derricks, construction elevators, construction hoists, gondolas and other designated machinery above a certain capacity. A powered forklift is designated under Article 12.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 下列何者屬施行細則第23條所列具有危險性之設備？
a_zh: 影印機
b_zh: 電腦主機
c_zh: 空氣清淨機
d_zh: 鍋爐
q_en: Which of the following is dangerous equipment under Enforcement Rules Article 23?
a_en: Photocopier
b_en: Computer server
c_en: Air purifier
d_en: Boiler
explain_zh: 施行細則第23條：危險性設備指一定容量以上之鍋爐、壓力容器、高壓氣體特定設備、高壓氣體容器及其他指定公告者。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 23: dangerous equipment includes boilers, pressure vessels, specified high-pressure gas equipment, high-pressure gas containers and other designated equipment above a certain capacity.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 下列何者不是施行細則第24條所列危險性機械設備之檢查項目？
a_zh: 重新檢查
b_zh: 竣工檢查
c_zh: 熔接檢查
d_zh: 年終檢查
q_en: Which of the following is NOT an inspection item for dangerous machinery and equipment under Enforcement Rules Article 24?
a_en: Re-inspection
b_en: Completion inspection
c_en: Welding inspection
d_en: Year-end inspection
explain_zh: 施行細則第24條列八項：熔接檢查、構造檢查、竣工檢查、定期檢查、重新檢查、型式檢查、使用檢查、變更檢查。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 24 lists eight items: welding, structural, completion, periodic, re-inspection, type, use and alteration inspections.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 作業場所有易燃液體之蒸氣或可燃性氣體滯留，達爆炸下限值之百分之多少以上，屬施行細則第25條「有立即發生危險之虞」？
a_zh: 百分之五十
b_zh: 百分之二十
c_zh: 百分之三十
d_zh: 百分之十
q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 25, flammable vapor or combustible gas accumulating at what percentage of the lower explosive limit constitutes 'imminent danger'?
explain_zh: 施行細則第25條第4款：於作業場所有易燃液體之蒸氣或可燃性氣體滯留，達爆炸下限值之百分之三十以上，致有發生爆炸、火災危險之虞時。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 25(4): flammable liquid vapor or combustible gas accumulating at 30% or more of the lower explosive limit, with risk of explosion or fire.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 於高度幾公尺以上作業，未設置防墜設施及未使勞工使用適當個人防護具，屬「有立即發生危險之虞」？
a_zh: 三公尺
b_zh: 二公尺
c_zh: 一公尺
d_zh: 一點五公尺
q_en: Working at a height of how many meters or more without fall-prevention facilities and appropriate PPE constitutes 'imminent danger'?
a_en: 3 m
b_en: 2 m
c_en: 1 m
explain_zh: 施行細則第25條第7款：於高度二公尺以上作業，未設置防墜設施及未使勞工使用適當之個人防護具，致有發生墜落危險之虞時。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 25(7): work at a height of 2 meters or more without fall-prevention facilities and appropriate personal protective equipment.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 從事河川工程、河堤、海堤或圍堰等作業，因何種情形致有發生危險之虞，屬施行細則第25條之情形？
a_zh: 材料短缺或機具故障
b_zh: 工期延誤或成本超支
c_zh: 人力不足或調度失當
d_zh: 強風、大雨或地震
q_en: For river works, embankments, seawalls or cofferdams, which condition creates 'imminent danger' under Enforcement Rules Article 25?
a_en: Material shortage or equipment failure
b_en: Schedule delay or cost overrun
c_en: Labor shortage or poor scheduling
d_en: Strong wind, heavy rain or earthquake
explain_zh: 施行細則第25條第2款：從事河川工程、河堤、海堤或圍堰等作業，因強風、大雨或地震，致有發生危險之虞時。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 25(2): river works, embankments, seawalls or cofferdam operations where strong wind, heavy rain or earthquake creates a risk of danger.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第十八條第三項及第三十九條第四項所稱之其他不利之處分，指何種措施？
a_zh: 指經勞資會議決議認定不利，並報請勞動檢查機構備查之管理措施
b_zh: 指直接或間接損害勞工依法令、契約或習慣上所應享有權益之措施
c_zh: 指雇主基於企業經營需要所為之調職、輪班或工作場所變更安排
d_zh: 指僅限於終止勞動契約、降低職位或減少工資等三種明定之措施
q_en: What are other disadvantageous measures under Articles 18-3 and 39-4 of the Act?
a_en: Measures found disadvantageous by a labor-management meeting and filed with the agency
b_en: Measures that directly or indirectly harm rights a worker holds by law, contract or custom
c_en: Transfers, shift changes or workplace changes made for genuine business operating needs
d_en: Only the three listed measures of dismissal, demotion in position, and reduction of wages
explain_zh: 第26條：本法第18條第3項及第39條第4項所稱其他不利之處分，指直接或間接損害勞工依法令、契約或習慣上所應享有權益之措施。本法第18條第3項禁止雇主對於勞工行使退避權後予以解僱、調職或其他不利之處分；第39條第4項則禁止雇主對申訴之工作者為不利處分。
explain_en: Article 26 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 施行細則第27條所稱「特殊健康檢查」，其對象為何？
a_zh: 從事特別危害健康作業之勞工
b_zh: 所有新僱用到職之勞工
c_zh: 年滿六十五歲之高齡勞工
d_zh: 職務列為主管級之人員
q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 27, who is the target of 'special health examinations'?
a_en: Laborers engaged in especially health-hazardous work
b_en: All newly hired laborers reporting for duty
c_en: Laborers who have reached the age of 65
d_en: Personnel holding supervisory-level positions
explain_zh: 施行細則第27條第2項第2款：特殊健康檢查指對從事特別危害健康作業之勞工，為發現健康有無異常，以提供健康指導、適性配工及分級管理等措施，依其作業危害性於一定期間或變更工作時所實施者。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 27(2)(2): special health examinations target laborers engaged in especially health-hazardous work, conducted periodically or upon job change to provide health guidance, fitness-based assignment and graded management.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本細則第二十八條現行條文之內容為何？
a_zh: 該條規定體格檢查紀錄至少保存七年，特殊健康檢查紀錄應保存三十年以上
b_zh: 該條規定勞工拒絕接受健康檢查時，雇主得逕予調整其工作或終止勞動契約
c_zh: 該條已刪除；體格檢查與各類健康檢查之定義，現規定於本細則第二十七條
d_zh: 該條規定特殊健康檢查應每年實施一次，並於檢查後三十日內通報主管機關
q_en: What does Article 28 of the Enforcement Rules currently contain?
a_en: It requires physical records to be kept seven years and special records for thirty years
b_en: It lets the employer reassign or dismiss a worker who refuses to take a health examination
c_en: It is deleted; physical and health examinations are defined in Article 27 of the Rules
d_en: It requires a special health examination yearly and a report to the authority in thirty days
explain_zh: 第28條：（刪除）。體格檢查、一般健康檢查、特殊健康檢查及特定對象與特定項目健康檢查之定義，規定於本細則第27條。勞工接受檢查之義務則規定於第29條，勞工自行於其他符合規定之醫療機構接受相當種類及項目之檢查並提供結果予雇主者，視為已接受本法第20條第1項之檢查。
explain_en: Article 28 was deleted; see Article 27.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 勞工自行於其他符合規定之醫療機構接受相當種類及項目之檢查，並將結果提供雇主者，效力如何？
a_zh: 須先報經勞動檢查機構核可始生效
b_zh: 不予承認，仍應由雇主重新安排檢查
c_zh: 視為已接受本法第20條第1項之檢查
d_zh: 僅承認其中一半之檢查項目效力
q_en: If a laborer undergoes equivalent examinations at another qualified medical institution and provides the results to the employer, what is the effect?
a_en: Effective only after approval by the labor inspection agency is obtained
b_en: Not recognized; the employer must arrange a fresh examination for the laborer
c_en: Deemed to have undergone the examination under Article 20(1) of the Act
d_en: Only half of the examination items are recognized as having legal effect
explain_zh: 施行細則第29條第2項：勞工自行於其他符合規定之醫療機構接受相當種類及項目之檢查，並將檢查結果提供予雇主者，視為已接受本法第二十條第一項之檢查。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 29(2): such examinations are deemed to satisfy Article 20(1) of the Act.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本細則第三十條之現行狀態為何？
a_zh: 業經刪除，惟其原定之健康管理分級措施仍應依原條文之規定繼續辦理
b_zh: 仍屬有效，規定雇主應建立勞工健康檢查資料庫並定期報請主管機關查核
c_zh: 仍屬有效，規定醫療機構應於檢查後十五日內將結果通報中央主管機關
d_zh: 業經刪除而無規範內容；勞工接受檢查義務之範圍係規定於本細則第二十九條
q_en: What is the current status of Article 30 of the Enforcement Rules?
a_en: Deleted, yet its health management grading measures must still be carried out as before
b_en: Still in force, requiring employers to build a health record database for periodic audit
c_en: Still in force, requiring medical bodies to report results to the ministry in fifteen days
d_en: Deleted with no content; the scope of the workers duty to be examined is in Article 29
explain_zh: 第30條：（刪除）。本法第20條第6項所稱勞工有接受檢查之義務，指勞工應依雇主安排於符合本法規定之醫療機構接受體格及健康檢查，規定於本細則第29條第1項。勞工違反第20條第6項者，依本法第46條第4項處新臺幣三千元以下罰鍰。
explain_en: Article 30 was deleted; see Article 29.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本細則第三十一條目前有無規範內容？
a_zh: 已刪除，惟其原定之醫護人員臨場服務頻率仍應依原條文之規定辦理
b_zh: 仍有內容，規定職業安全衛生管理單位應置專職人員之勞工人數門檻
c_zh: 已刪除而無內容；安全衛生組織之種類與定義係規定於本細則第三十二條
d_zh: 仍有內容，規定職業安全衛生委員會之委員人數、任期及其開會之頻率
q_en: Does Article 31 of the Enforcement Rules still have content?
a_en: No, it is deleted, but its on-site medical service frequency still applies as written
b_en: Yes, it sets the worker headcount at which a full-time management unit staff is required
c_en: No, it is deleted; the kinds of safety and health organisation are set out in Article 32
d_en: Yes, it sets the number of committee members, their term and how often they must meet
explain_zh: 第31條：（刪除）。本法第23條第1項所定安全衛生組織，依本細則第32條包括職業安全衛生管理單位（擬訂、規劃、推動及督導安全衛生業務）及職業安全衛生委員會（審議、協調、考核及建議安全衛生業務）。安全衛生人員之範圍則規定於第33條。
explain_en: Article 31 was deleted; see Article 32.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 施行細則第32條所定安全衛生組織中，「職業安全衛生委員會」之功能為何？
a_zh: 執行、督辦、稽查及裁處勞動檢查有關業務
b_zh: 核發、換發、註銷及管理操作證照有關業務
c_zh: 審議、協調、考核及建議職業安全衛生有關業務
d_zh: 擬訂、規劃、推動及督導職業安全衛生有關業務
q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 32, what is the function of the 'Occupational Safety and Health Committee'?
a_en: To conduct, supervise, audit and penalize in labor inspection matters
b_en: To issue, renew, revoke and manage operator licensing matters
c_en: To deliberate, coordinate, evaluate and advise on OSH matters
d_en: To draft, plan, promote and supervise OSH-related matters
explain_zh: 施行細則第32條：職業安全衛生管理單位為擬訂、規劃、推動及督導之組織；職業安全衛生委員會為審議、協調、考核及建議之組織。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 32: the OSH management unit drafts, plans, promotes and supervises; the OSH committee deliberates, coordinates, evaluates and advises.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 下列何者不屬施行細則第33條所稱之安全衛生人員？
a_zh: 職業安全衛生業務主管
b_zh: 職業衛生管理師
c_zh: 職業安全管理師
d_zh: 勞動檢查員
q_en: Which of the following is NOT 'safety and health personnel' under Enforcement Rules Article 33?
a_en: OSH business supervisor
b_en: Occupational hygiene management specialist
c_en: Occupational safety management specialist
d_en: Labor inspector
explain_zh: 施行細則第33條：安全衛生人員包括職業安全衛生業務主管、職業安全管理師、職業衛生管理師、職業安全衛生管理員。勞動檢查員為政府人員。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 33: safety and health personnel include the OSH business supervisor, occupational safety management specialist, occupational hygiene management specialist and OSH administrator. A labor inspector is a government official.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本細則第三十四條之效力如何？
a_zh: 仍屬有效，規定職業安全管理師及職業衛生管理師之訓練時數與其測驗
b_zh: 仍屬有效，規定安全衛生人員異動時應於三十日內報請檢查機構備查
c_zh: 業經刪除；安全衛生人員之範圍係規定於本細則第三十三條，共含四類人員
d_zh: 業經刪除，惟其原定之管理員設置人數表仍列為附表而繼續適用至今
q_en: What is the effect of Article 34 of the Enforcement Rules?
a_en: It is in force and sets training hours and tests for safety and health management engineers
b_en: It is in force and requires changes of safety personnel to be filed within thirty days
c_en: It is deleted; the four kinds of safety and health personnel are listed in Article 33
d_en: It is deleted, yet its staffing table for management officers still applies as an annex
explain_zh: 第34條：（刪除）。本法第23條第1項所稱安全衛生人員，依本細則第33條指事業單位內擬訂、規劃及推動安全衛生管理業務者，包括職業安全衛生業務主管、職業安全管理師、職業衛生管理師及職業安全衛生管理員四類。第35條則定職業安全衛生管理系統之意義。
explain_en: Article 34 was deleted; see Article 33.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第二十三條第二項所稱之職業安全衛生管理系統，其定義為何？
a_zh: 指事業單位依其規模、性質，建立包括規劃、實施、評估及改善措施之系統化管理體制
b_zh: 指以職業安全衛生委員會為核心，審議協調考核安全衛生業務之組織體系
c_zh: 指由中央主管機關公告之國際標準，事業單位應完全比照建置並取得驗證
d_zh: 指事業單位為推動自動檢查所建立之機械設備定期檢查與紀錄保存制度
q_en: What is an occupational safety and health management system under Article 23-2 of the Act?
a_en: A systematic regime built to the units scale and nature covering planning, doing, checking and acting
b_en: An organisational structure centred on the safety committee for review, coordination and appraisal
c_en: An international standard announced by the ministry that every unit must adopt and be certified to
d_en: A regime of periodic machine checks and record keeping set up to carry out automatic inspections
explain_zh: 第35條：本法第23條第2項所稱職業安全衛生管理系統，指事業單位依其規模、性質，建立包括規劃、實施、評估及改善措施之系統化管理體制。本法第23條第2項規定中央主管機關指定之事業，雇主應建置職業安全衛生管理系統，並經勞動檢查機構或中央主管機關認可之機構訪查、認可其績效。
explain_en: Article 35 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第26條所定交付承攬時之事前告知，依施行細則第36條應以何種方式辦理？
a_zh: 由現場主管於開工前向承攬人以口頭告知即可
b_zh: 由承辦人員以電話通知承攬人負責人即可
c_zh: 將應告知事項張貼於事業單位布告欄公告即可
d_zh: 提供書面或電子文件，或召開協商會議並作成紀錄
q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 36, how shall the prior notification under Article 26 of the Act be made when contracting out?
a_en: By the site supervisor verbally informing the contractor before the work begins on site
b_en: By a staff member telephoning the person in charge of the contractor firm
c_en: By posting the matters to be notified on the enterprise's bulletin board only
d_en: By providing written or electronic documents, or by holding a consultation meeting with minutes
explain_zh: 施行細則第36條：事前告知應依下列方式之一辦理：一、於交付承攬時，提供書面或電子文件。二、召開協商會議，並作成紀錄。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 36: prior notification shall be made by providing written or electronic documents at the time of contracting, or by holding a consultation meeting with written records.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第二十六條第三項所稱之工作場所或設備範圍為何？其事前告知應如何辦理？
a_zh: 指建築物、屋頂、機械、器具、車輛或其他職安法令所定設備；應於出租或出借前以書面或電子文件告知
b_zh: 指營造工程之施工架、模板支撐及開挖場所；應於契約簽訂時以口頭說明並作成談話紀錄存查
c_zh: 指僅限於危險性機械及危險性設備；應於出租或出借後七日內以書面通知承租人並副知檢查機構
d_zh: 指經中央主管機關公告指定之高風險設備；應於每次使用前由承租人自行檢點並填具檢查表
q_en: What are the workplaces or equipment under Article 26-3 of the Act, and how is prior notice given?
a_en: Buildings, roofs, machines, tools, vehicles or other equipment under OSH law; notice in writing before hire
b_en: Scaffolds, formwork supports and excavations in construction; oral notice recorded when signing
c_en: Only dangerous machinery and equipment; written notice to the hirer within seven days after the hire
d_en: High risk equipment designated by the ministry; the hirer checks it and fills a form before each use
explain_zh: 第36條之1第1項：本法第26條第3項所稱工作場所或設備，指建築物、屋頂、機械、器具、車輛或其他職業安全衛生法令所定之設備。第2項：事前告知應於出租或出借前以書面或電子文件為之，其告知危害因素及安全衛生注意事項之內容，應包括可能引起之危害及依職業安全衛生法令所應採取之措施。第36條則規範交付承攬時之事前告知方式。
explain_en: Article 36-1 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 施行細則第37條所稱「共同作業」，指下列何者？
a_zh: 不同公司之工作者，於同一期間、不同工作場所各自分別從事工作
b_zh: 承攬人之工作者，於同一期間、其自有廠房場所內單獨從事工作
c_zh: 同一事業單位之工作者，於不同期間、同一工作場所輪班從事工作
d_zh: 事業單位與承攬人、再承攬人之工作者，於同一期間、同一工作場所從事工作
q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 37, 'joint operation' means:
a_en: Workers of different companies each working separately during the same period at different workplaces
b_en: Workers of a contractor working alone during the same period inside its own factory premises
c_en: Workers of the same enterprise working in shifts during different periods at the same workplace
d_en: Workers of the enterprise, contractors and subcontractors working during the same period at the same workplace
explain_zh: 施行細則第37條：共同作業，指事業單位與承攬人、再承攬人之工作者，於同一期間、同一工作場所從事工作。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 37: joint operation means workers of the enterprise, contractors and subcontractors working during the same period at the same workplace.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 施行細則第38條協議組織應協議之事項，包括對下列何種危險作業之管制？
a_zh: 文書處理、會計帳務、採購發包等
b_zh: 行銷企劃、客戶服務、廣告宣傳等
c_zh: 動火、高架、開挖、爆破、高壓電活線等
d_zh: 教育訓練、人員招募、績效考核等
q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 38, the coordination organization shall discuss the control of which dangerous operations?
a_en: Document handling, accounting entries, procurement and contracting, etc.
b_en: Marketing planning, customer service, advertising and promotion, etc.
c_en: Hot work, work at height, excavation, blasting, live high-voltage work, etc.
d_en: Education and training, staff recruitment, performance appraisal, etc.
explain_zh: 施行細則第38條第3款：從事動火、高架、開挖、爆破、高壓電活線等危險作業之管制。其他包括安全衛生管理配合、局限空間及危險物有害物作業環境管制、變更管理、統一信號標示、機械設備使用協調、高低氣溫作業風險預防等。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 38(3): control of dangerous operations such as hot work, work at height, excavation, blasting and live high-voltage work; other items include coordination of management, confined space and hazardous substance control, change management, unified signals and signage, equipment use coordination, and high/low temperature risk prevention.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第三十一條第一項所稱有母性健康危害之虞之工作，包括下列何者？
a_zh: 暴露於具生殖毒性物質、生殖細胞致突變性物質或其他對哺乳功能有不良影響之化學品之工作
b_zh: 經醫師評估認有危害之虞，且勞工本人以書面表示不願繼續從事之各類作業或工作
c_zh: 凡從事夜間工作、每月加班超過四十六小時或需長時間站立達四小時以上之各類工作
d_zh: 暴露於屬致癌物質第一級或呼吸道致敏物質，且作業環境監測結果超過容許暴露標準之工作
q_en: Which work risks maternal health under Article 31-1 of the Act?
a_en: Exposure to reproductive toxicants, germ cell mutagens or other chemicals that harm lactation
b_en: Any work a physician deems risky and that the worker states in writing she will not continue
c_en: Any night work, overtime beyond forty-six hours a month, or standing for four hours or longer
d_en: Exposure to category 1 carcinogens or respiratory sensitisers above the permissible exposure limit
explain_zh: 第39條：有母性健康危害之虞之工作，指可能影響胚胎發育、妊娠或哺乳期間之母體及幼兒健康之工作，包括暴露於依CNS 15030分類屬生殖毒性物質、生殖細胞致突變性物質或其他對哺乳功能有不良影響之化學品者；勞工個人工作型態（作業姿勢、人力提舉、搬運、推拉重物、輪班及工作負荷等）易造成健康危害者；及其他經中央主管機關指定公告者。
explain_en: Article 39 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 雇主依本法第三十三條規定宣導本法及有關安全衛生規定時，得以何種方式為之？
a_zh: 應報經勞動檢查機構核定宣導計畫後，依核定之方式及時程辦理並作成紀錄
b_zh: 得以教育、公告、分發印刷品、集會報告、電子郵件、網際網路或其他足使勞工周知之方式
c_zh: 應以集合全體勞工實施面授教育之方式為之，不得以書面或電子方式替代辦理
d_zh: 得委由職業安全衛生顧問服務機構代為辦理，並以其出具之報告書作為憑證
q_en: How may an employer publicise the Act and safety rules under Article 33?
a_en: Only after the inspection agency approves a plan, following the approved method and schedule
b_en: By training, notices, printed matter, meetings, email, the internet or any way workers will know
c_en: Only by face-to-face instruction of all workers assembled; written or electronic means are barred
d_en: By entrusting a consulting service body and using its report as the evidence of compliance
explain_zh: 第40條：雇主依本法第33條規定宣導本法及有關安全衛生規定時，得以教育、公告、分發印刷品、集會報告、電子郵件、網際網路或其他足使勞工周知之方式為之。本法第33條課雇主負宣導義務，與第32條之安全衛生教育訓練義務並行。
explain_en: Article 40 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 下列何者不是施行細則第41條所定安全衛生工作守則應包含之內容？
a_zh: 事業之安全衛生管理及各級之權責
b_zh: 事故通報及報告
c_zh: 急救及搶救
d_zh: 公司年度營收目標
q_en: Which of the following is NOT required content of the safety and health work rules under Enforcement Rules Article 41?
a_en: Safety and health management and responsibilities at each level
b_en: Accident notification and reporting
c_en: First aid and rescue
d_en: The company's annual revenue target
explain_zh: 施行細則第41條列十款：安全衛生管理及各級權責、機械設備器具操作規範與維護檢查、工作安全衛生標準、教育訓練、健康指導及管理、急救及搶救、防護設備之準備維持使用、個人防護具維護使用、事故通報及報告、其他安全衛生事項。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 41 lists ten items including management responsibilities, equipment operation and maintenance, work safety standards, training, health guidance, first aid and rescue, protective equipment, PPE, accident reporting and other matters.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 安全衛生工作守則之訂定範圍及備查程序為何？跨轄區者應如何辦理？
a_zh: 得依事業實際需要分別訂定，報請勞動檢查機構備查；跨二以上檢查機構轄區者，報請中央主管機關指定之勞動檢查機構備查
b_zh: 得依工作性質分別訂定，報請當地主管機關核備；跨二以上直轄市轄區者，應分別向各該直轄市之主管機關報備
c_zh: 應由職業安全衛生委員會決議後實施而無須報備；跨二以上檢查機構轄區者，僅須通知各該勞動檢查機構備查
d_zh: 應就全部事業一體訂定，報請勞動檢查機構核准；跨二以上檢查機構轄區者，應報請中央主管機關核准後始得公告實施
q_en: How are safety and health work rules made and filed, and what if they cross jurisdictions?
a_en: They may be made separately as needed and filed with the inspection agency; if across two, with the designated one
b_en: They may be made by work type and filed with the local authority; if across cities, filed with each city separately
c_en: They take effect on a committee resolution with no filing; if across two agencies, each is merely notified
d_en: They must cover the whole business and be approved by the agency; if across two, approved by the ministry first
explain_zh: 第42條：前條之安全衛生工作守則，得依事業單位之實際需要，訂定適用於全部或一部分事業，並得依工作性質、規模分別訂定，報請勞動檢查機構備查；其適用區域跨二以上勞動檢查機構轄區時，應報請中央主管機關指定之勞動檢查機構備查。守則內容依第41條共十款；勞工代表之產生方式依第43條。
explain_en: Article 42 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 事業單位設有工會者，本法第34條及第37條所定「勞工代表」由何者產生？
a_zh: 由雇主指定
b_zh: 由勞動檢查機構指派
c_zh: 由資深員工自動擔任
d_zh: 由工會推派
q_en: In an enterprise with a labor union, how are the 'laborer representatives' under Articles 34 and 37 of the Act selected?
a_en: Designated by the employer
b_en: Assigned by the labor inspection agency
c_en: Automatically the most senior employees
d_en: Nominated by the union
explain_zh: 施行細則第43條：勞工代表，事業單位設有工會者，由工會推派之；無工會組織而有勞資會議者，由勞方代表推選之；無工會組織且無勞資會議者，由勞工共同推選之。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 43: with a union, nominated by the union; without a union but with a labor-management meeting, elected by the labor-side representatives; with neither, elected jointly by the laborers.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 中央主管機關或勞動檢查機構為執行職業安全衛生監督及檢查，對代行檢查機構得為何種要求？
a_zh: 得逕行撤銷代行檢查機構之指定，並命其於三十日內移交全部檢查紀錄及帳冊
b_zh: 應每季派員進駐代行檢查機構，全程監督其檢查作業並簽署檢查合格之證明文件
c_zh: 於必要時，得要求代行檢查機構或代行檢查人員提出相關報告、紀錄、帳冊、文件或說明
d_zh: 得要求代行檢查機構就其代行檢查所收之費用，按比例繳交監督管理規費予國庫
q_en: What may the ministry or an inspection agency require of an accredited inspection agency?
a_en: That its designation be revoked at once and all inspection records and books handed over in thirty days
b_en: That an officer be stationed at the agency each quarter to supervise and sign its certificates of compliance
c_en: Where necessary, that the agency or its inspectors produce reports, records, books, documents or explanations
d_en: That it pay a proportion of the fees it collects to the treasury as a supervision and management charge
explain_zh: 第44條：中央主管機關或勞動檢查機構為執行職業安全衛生監督及檢查，於必要時，得要求代行檢查機構或代行檢查人員，提出相關報告、紀錄、帳冊、文件或說明。代行檢查機構違反本法或依本法所發布之命令者，依本法第47條處新臺幣六萬元以上三十萬元以下罰鍰。
explain_en: Article 44 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第三十五條所定之職業安全衛生諮詢會，其委員人數、任期及遴聘方式為何？
a_zh: 置委員九人至十五人，任期二年，由中央主管機關就勞工團體、雇主團體、職災勞工團體、有關機關代表及學者專家遴聘
b_zh: 置委員十一人至十七人，任期四年，由勞動檢查機構就轄區內勞資雙方代表及專家學者推薦後遴聘
c_zh: 置委員七人至十一人，任期三年，由行政院就勞工團體、雇主團體、有關機關代表及安全衛生學者專家聘任之
d_zh: 置委員十五人至二十一人，任期一年，由中央主管機關就各目的事業主管機關及事業單位代表指派之
q_en: How many members does the OSH consultative committee have, and how are they appointed?
a_en: Nine to fifteen members for two years, appointed by the ministry from labor, employer, victim groups and experts
b_en: Eleven to seventeen members for four years, appointed by inspection agencies on local nominations
c_en: Seven to eleven members for three years, appointed by the Executive Yuan from labor, employer groups and experts
d_en: Fifteen to twenty-one members for one year, designated by the ministry from line ministries and enterprises
explain_zh: 第45條：本法第35條所定職業安全衛生諮詢會，置委員九人至十五人，任期二年，由中央主管機關就勞工團體、雇主團體、職業災害勞工團體、有關機關代表及安全衛生學者專家遴聘之。本法第35條規定中央主管機關為監督管理及研議全國性職業病防治政策，得設職業安全衛生諮詢會。
explain_en: Article 45 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 勞動檢查機構依本法第三十六條第一項規定實施安全衛生檢查、通知限期改善或停工之程序，應依何規定辦理？
a_zh: 應依各該直轄市主管機關自行訂定之檢查作業要點辦理，不受本法拘束
b_zh: 應依行政程序法之聽證程序辦理，並於聽證終結後始得作成停工之處分
c_zh: 應依勞動檢查法之相關規定辦理，包括其檢查、通知改善及停工之程序規定
d_zh: 應依職業安全衛生管理辦法之相關規定辦理，並報請中央主管機關核定
q_en: Which law governs the procedure for inspections, correction notices and stop-work orders under Article 36-1?
a_en: Guidelines each municipal authority writes for itself, which are not bound by this Act at all
b_en: The hearing procedure of the Administrative Procedure Act, with a stop order only after the hearing
c_en: The Labor Inspection Act, including its rules on inspection, correction notices and stop-work orders
d_en: The Occupational Safety and Health Management Regulations, subject to approval by the ministry
explain_zh: 第46條：勞動檢查機構依本法第36條第1項規定實施安全衛生檢查、通知限期改善或停工之程序，應依勞動檢查法相關規定辦理。勞動檢查法第25條定檢查結果應於十日內以書面通知立即改正或限期改善；第27條至第29條則分別規定重大職業災害、立即發生危險之虞及未依限改善之停工通知。
explain_en: Article 46 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 施行細則第46條之1所定發生職業災害時雇主應即採取之急救、搶救措施，包括下列何者？
a_zh: 對發生職業災害之工作場所進行人員清點，及管制現場，禁止其他工作者進入
b_zh: 對發生職業災害之工作場所立即清理現場，並儘速恢復原有作業
c_zh: 對發生職業災害之工作場所先行聯絡保險公司，並辦理理賠申請
d_zh: 對發生職業災害之工作場所先行通知新聞媒體，並安排採訪拍攝
q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 46-1, the employer's immediate first aid and rescue measures after an occupational accident include:
a_en: Conducting a headcount at the accident site and controlling the scene to prohibit entry of other workers
b_en: Immediately clearing the accident site and restoring the original operations as quickly as possible
c_en: Contacting the insurance company about the accident site first and filing the claim application
d_en: Notifying the news media about the accident site first and arranging interviews and filming there
explain_zh: 施行細則第46條之1：使有立即危險之虞之工作者退避至安全場所；對災害工作場所進行人員清點及管制現場，禁止其他工作者進入；提供緊急應變人員必要之個人防護具與設備及規劃緊急撤離機制；其他必要緊急應變措施。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 46-1: withdraw workers at imminent risk to safety; conduct headcounts and control the scene to bar other workers; provide PPE and equipment to emergency responders and plan evacuation; other necessary emergency measures.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第37條第2項「八小時內通報」之起算時點為何？應向何者通報？
a_zh: 自事業單位明知或可得而知已發生職業災害事實起；向事業單位所在轄區之勞動檢查機構通報
b_zh: 自醫療機構開立診斷證明書之日起算；向承保之商業保險公司總機構通報
c_zh: 自災害發生之時起屆滿二十四小時起算；向事業單位所在轄區之警察機關通報
d_zh: 自新聞媒體首次報導該災害之時起算；向勞動部職業安全衛生署通報
q_en: When does the 8-hour reporting period under Article 37(2) begin, and to whom is the report made?
a_en: From when the enterprise knew or could have known of the accident; to the labor inspection agency of the jurisdiction where the enterprise is located
b_en: From the date the medical institution issues the diagnostic certificate; to the head office of the commercial insurer that underwrote the policy
c_en: From the moment 24 full hours have elapsed after the accident occurred; to the police agency of the jurisdiction where the enterprise is located
d_en: From when the news media first report the accident; to the Occupational Safety and Health Administration of the Ministry of Labor
explain_zh: 施行細則第47條第1項：應於八小時內通報，指事業單位明知或可得而知已發生規定之職業災害事實起八小時內，應向其事業單位所在轄區之勞動檢查機構通報。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 47(1): the 8 hours run from when the enterprise knew or could have known that a reportable accident occurred, and the report goes to the labor inspection agency of the jurisdiction where the enterprise is located.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第37條第2項第2款「罹災人數在三人以上」，依施行細則第48條係指哪些失能類型之總人數？
a_zh: 永久全失能及永久部分失能，不含暫時全失能
b_zh: 門診治療之輕傷人數，不含住院或失能個案
c_zh: 死亡及永久全失能，不含部分失能或暫時失能
d_zh: 永久全失能、永久部分失能及暫時全失能
q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 48, 'three or more victims' in Article 37(2)(2) counts the total of which disability types?
a_en: Permanent total disability and permanent partial disability, excluding temporary disability
b_en: Minor injuries treated as outpatients, excluding hospitalized or disabled cases
c_en: Deaths and permanent total disability, excluding any partial or temporary disability
d_en: Permanent total disability, permanent partial disability and temporary total disability
explain_zh: 施行細則第48條第1項：罹災人數在三人以上者，指於勞動場所同一災害發生工作者永久全失能、永久部分失能及暫時全失能之總人數達三人以上者。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 48(1): the total number of workers with permanent total disability, permanent partial disability and temporary total disability in the same accident reaching three or more.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 施行細則第49條所稱「重傷之災害」，須住院治療連續達多少小時以上？
a_zh: 四十八小時
b_zh: 二十四小時
c_zh: 十二小時
d_zh: 八小時
q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 49, a 'serious injury accident' requires continuous hospitalization of at least how many hours?
a_en: 48 hours
b_en: 24 hours
c_en: 12 hours
d_en: 8 hours
explain_zh: 施行細則第49條第2項：重傷之災害，指造成罹災者肢體或器官嚴重受損，危及生命或造成其身體機能嚴重喪失，且須住院治療連續達二十四小時以上之災害者。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 49(2): serious injury means severe damage to limbs or organs that endangers life or causes serious loss of bodily function, requiring continuous hospitalization of 24 hours or more.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第三十七條第四項所稱之雇主及現場，其範圍分別為何？
a_zh: 雇主僅指罹災勞工之雇主；現場指罹災勞工當時所在之位置及其半徑五十公尺以內之全部範圍
b_zh: 雇主指災害發生現場所有事業單位之雇主；現場指造成災害之機械、設備、器具、原料、材料等物件及其作業場所
c_zh: 雇主指原事業單位之雇主；現場指經勞動檢查機構以警示標誌圍起並公告禁止進入之區域
d_zh: 雇主指承攬人及再承攬人之雇主；現場指事業單位登記之營業所在地及其附屬之倉儲場所
q_en: Who is the employer and what is the scene under Article 37-4 of the Act?
a_en: Employer means only the injured workers employer; scene means everything within fifty metres of the worker
b_en: Employer means every unit at the scene; scene means the machines, tools and materials involved and the site
c_en: Employer means the original enterprise; scene means the area the inspection agency has cordoned off
d_en: Employer means the contractors and subcontractors; scene means the registered premises and warehouses
explain_zh: 第50條：本法第37條第4項所稱雇主，指災害發生現場所有事業單位之雇主；所稱現場，指造成災害之機械、設備、器具、原料、材料等相關物件及其作業場所。本法第37條第4項規定除必要之急救、搶救外，雇主非經司法機關或勞動檢查機構許可，不得移動或破壞現場。
explain_en: Article 50 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 依施行細則第51條，勞工人數在多少人以上之事業，應依本法第38條按月填報職業災害統計？
a_zh: 一百人
b_zh: 十人
c_zh: 三十人
d_zh: 五十人
q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 51, enterprises with how many laborers or more shall file monthly occupational accident statistics under Article 38?
explain_zh: 施行細則第51條第1項：本法第38條所定中央主管機關指定之事業：一、勞工人數在三十人以上之事業。二、勞工人數未滿三十人之事業，經中央主管機關指定者。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 51(1): enterprises with 30 or more laborers, and enterprises with fewer than 30 laborers if designated by the central competent authority.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 勞工因雇主違反本法規定致發生職業災害而提起訴訟時，得如何獲得協助？
a_zh: 得向中央主管機關申請扶助；該扶助業務，中央主管機關並得委託民間團體辦理
b_zh: 得向法律扶助基金會申請，其費用由雇主依裁判結果全額償還予該基金會
c_zh: 應先經勞資爭議調解不成立，始得向直轄市主管機關申請訴訟費用之補助
d_zh: 得向勞動檢查機構申請扶助；該扶助業務，應由勞動檢查機構自行辦理之
q_en: What help is available to a worker suing over an occupational accident caused by a breach of the Act?
a_en: Assistance may be sought from the central authority, which may entrust the work to a private group
b_en: Application goes to the Legal Aid Foundation, with the employer repaying the cost in full after trial
c_en: Mediation must fail first, and only then may litigation cost aid be sought from the city authority
d_en: Assistance may be sought from the inspection agency, which must handle the matter by itself
explain_zh: 第52條：勞工因雇主違反本法規定致發生職業災害所提起之訴訟，得向中央主管機關申請扶助；前項扶助業務，中央主管機關得委託民間團體辦理。此與本法第39條工作者申訴機制及第39條第4項禁止不利處分之規定，共同構成勞工權益之保障。
explain_en: Article 52 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 直轄市與縣（市）主管機關及各目的事業主管機關應積極辦理之職業安全衛生業務，包括下列何者？
a_zh: 策略及規劃、法規及制度、推動及實施、督導及成效評估、檢討及持續改善等事項
b_zh: 作業環境監測機構之認可、化學品登記之審查及新化學物質資訊之公開等
c_zh: 職業災害勞工之補償給付、職業病之認定及勞工保險費率之核定等業務事項
d_zh: 檢查及裁罰、代行檢查機構之指定、危險性機械設備之檢查及型式驗證等事項
q_en: Which duties must municipal and line authorities actively carry out?
a_en: Strategy and planning, law and systems, promotion, supervision and appraisal, and continual improvement
b_en: Accrediting monitoring bodies, reviewing chemical registrations and disclosing new substance data
c_en: Compensation for injured workers, recognition of occupational diseases, and setting insurance rates
d_en: Inspection and penalties, designating inspection agencies, checking dangerous machinery and verification
explain_zh: 第53條：本法第50條第2項所定直轄市與縣（市）主管機關及各目的事業主管機關，應依有關法令規定配合國家職業安全衛生政策，積極辦理策略及規劃、法規及制度、推動及實施、督導及成效評估、檢討及持續改善，以及其他安全衛生促進活動等業務。中央主管機關並得依本法第50條第2項訂定績效評核及獎勵辦法。
explain_en: Article 53 of the Enforcement Rules.

law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
q_zh: 職業安全衛生法施行細則於民國115年6月26日修正發布之條文，自何日施行？
q_en: The provisions of the Enforcement Rules amended and promulgated on 26 June 2026 (ROC 115) take effect on:
a_en: 1 January 2027
b_en: 31 December 2026
c_en: 26 June 2026
d_en: 1 July 2026
explain_zh: 施行細則第54條：一百十五年六月二十六日修正發布之條文，自一百十五年七月一日施行。
explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 54: the provisions amended on 26 June ROC 115 (2026) take effect on 1 July ROC 115 (2026).

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 職業安全衛生管理辦法係依職業安全衛生法第幾條規定訂定？
a_zh: 第二十三條第五項
b_zh: 第十九條第二項
c_zh: 第六條第三項
d_zh: 第三十二條第三項
q_en: The Regulations of OSH Management are enacted under which article of the OSH Act?
a_en: Article 23, paragraph 5
b_en: Article 19, paragraph 2
c_en: Article 6, paragraph 3
d_en: Article 32, paragraph 3
explain_zh: 第1條：本辦法依職業安全衛生法第二十三條第五項規定訂定之。第1條之1：雇主應依事業規模性質設置安全衛生組織及人員，建立管理制度，透過規劃、實施、評估及改善實現管理目標。
explain_en: Article 1: under Article 23(5); Article 1-1 requires employers to set up an OSH organization and management system with plan-do-check-act functions.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
category: 職安管理辦法-管理制度
q_zh: 依本辦法，雇主應如何建立職業安全衛生管理制度？透過哪些管理功能實現安全衛生管理目標？
a_zh: 依主管機關指定之格式投保雇主責任保險，透過通報、理賠、補償及重建等機制提升管理水準
b_zh: 依中央主管機關核定之計畫全部委外辦理，透過委託、監造、查驗及結算等作業提升管理水準
c_zh: 依事業之勞工人數設置工會及勞資會議代表，透過協商、仲裁、調解及申訴等程序提升管理水準
d_zh: 依事業之規模、性質設置安全衛生組織及人員，透過規劃、實施、評估及改善措施等管理功能提升水準
q_en: How must an employer build the occupational safety and health management system, and through what management functions?
a_en: Take out employer liability insurance on an official form, then report, settle claims, compensate and rehabilitate
b_en: Outsource the whole matter under a plan approved by the authority, then commission, supervise, inspect and settle
c_en: Set up a union and labor-management meeting seats by headcount, then negotiate, arbitrate, mediate and appeal
d_en: Set up units and personnel by scale and nature, then plan, implement, evaluate and improve to raise standards
explain_zh: 第1條之1：雇主應依其事業之規模、性質，設置安全衛生組織及人員，建立職業安全衛生管理制度，透過規劃、實施、評估及改善措施等管理功能，實現安全衛生管理目標，提升安全衛生管理水準。第2條之1、第3條、第6條並定明管理單位與管理人員之設置規模。
explain_en: Article 1-1 requires plan-do-check-act style management functions.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 職業安全衛生管理辦法依危害風險將事業分為幾類？第一類事業指何者？
a_zh: 五類；具特殊風險者
b_zh: 三類；具顯著風險者
c_zh: 四類；具低度風險者
d_zh: 二類；具中度風險者
q_en: How many risk categories of enterprises are there, and what is Category 1?
a_en: Five; enterprises with special risk
b_en: Three; enterprises with significant risk
c_en: Four; enterprises with the lowest risk
d_en: Two; enterprises with moderate risk
explain_zh: 第2條：第一類事業具顯著風險、第二類事業具中度風險、第三類事業具低度風險；各類事業例示如附表一。
explain_en: Article 2: Category 1 = significant risk, Category 2 = moderate risk, Category 3 = low risk, with examples in Annex 1.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第一類事業之事業單位勞工人數在幾人以上，應設直接隸屬雇主之專責一級管理單位？
a_zh: 三百人以上
b_zh: 五百人以上
c_zh: 一百人以上
d_zh: 三十人以上
q_en: A Category 1 enterprise with at least how many workers must set up a dedicated first-level OSH management unit directly under the employer?
explain_zh: 第2條之1：第一類事業勞工人數一百人以上應設直接隸屬雇主之專責一級管理單位；第二類事業三百人以上應設直接隸屬雇主之一級管理單位。
explain_en: Article 2-1: Category 1 with 100+ workers needs a dedicated first-level unit; Category 2 with 300+ needs a first-level unit directly under the employer.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第二類事業勞工人數在幾人以上，應設直接隸屬雇主之一級管理單位？
a_zh: 一千人以上
b_zh: 一百人以上
c_zh: 五十人以上
d_zh: 三百人以上
q_en: A Category 2 enterprise with at least how many workers must set up a first-level management unit directly under the employer?
explain_zh: 第2條之1第1項第2款：第二類事業勞工人數在三百人以上者，應設直接隸屬雇主之一級管理單位。
explain_en: Article 2-1(1)(2): Category 2 enterprises with 300 or more workers.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第一類事業之事業單位勞工人數在一百人以上者，所置管理人員應為專職；第二類事業三百人以上者，所置管理人員至少幾人為專職？
a_zh: 三人
b_zh: 全部
c_zh: 二人
d_zh: 一人
q_en: For Category 2 enterprises with 300+ workers, at least how many OSH management personnel must be full-time?
a_en: Three
b_en: All
c_en: Two
d_en: One
explain_zh: 第3條第2項：第一類事業勞工人數一百人以上者，所置管理人員應為專職；第二類事業三百人以上者，所置管理人員應至少一人為專職。專職人員應常駐廠場，不得兼任其他法令所定專責人員或從事無關工作。
explain_en: Article 3(2): Category 1 with 100+ workers: all management personnel full-time; Category 2 with 300+: at least one full-time. Full-time staff must be stationed on site and not hold other statutory posts.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第一類事業（營造業以外）之事業單位勞工人數未滿三十人者，應置何種職業安全衛生人員？
a_zh: 乙種職業安全衛生業務主管
b_zh: 丙種職業安全衛生業務主管
c_zh: 職業安全衛生管理員
d_zh: 甲種職業安全衛生業務主管
q_en: A Category 1 (non-construction) enterprise with fewer than 30 workers must appoint:
a_en: A Class B OSH business supervisor
b_en: A Class C OSH business supervisor
c_en: An OSH administrator
d_en: A Class A OSH business supervisor
explain_zh: 附表二：各類事業未滿三十人者均置丙種職業安全衛生業務主管；三十人以上未滿一百人置乙種業務主管（第一類營造業另加管理員一人）；一百人以上置甲種業務主管。
explain_en: Annex 2: under 30 workers → Class C supervisor for all categories; 30–99 → Class B (construction Category 1 also adds an administrator); 100+ → Class A.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第一類事業之營造業事業單位勞工人數三十人以上未滿一百人者，依附表二應置何種人員？
a_zh: 乙種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理師各二人
b_zh: 乙種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理員各一人
c_zh: 甲種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理員各二人
d_zh: 丙種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理師各一人
q_en: A construction enterprise (Category 1) with 30 to under 100 workers must appoint, per Annex 2:
a_en: Two Class B OSH business supervisors and two management specialists
b_en: One Class B OSH business supervisor and one OSH administrator
c_en: Two Class A OSH business supervisors and two OSH administrators
d_en: One Class C OSH business supervisor and one management specialist
explain_zh: 附表二：營造業之事業單位三十人以上未滿一百人者，應置乙種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理員各一人；營造業以外之第一類事業同規模僅置乙種業務主管。
explain_en: Annex 2: construction enterprises of 30–99 workers need a Class B supervisor plus an administrator; non-construction Category 1 of the same size needs only the Class B supervisor.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第一類事業之營造業事業單位勞工人數三百人以上未滿五百人者，依附表二應置何種人員？
a_zh: 甲種業務主管二人、職業安全（衛生）管理師二人及職業安全衛生管理員三人
b_zh: 丙種業務主管一人、職業安全（衛生）管理師一人及職業安全衛生管理員四人
c_zh: 乙種業務主管一人、職業安全（衛生）管理師二人及職業安全衛生管理員一人
d_zh: 甲種業務主管一人、職業安全（衛生）管理師一人及職業安全衛生管理員二人
q_en: A construction enterprise (Category 1) with 300 to under 500 workers must appoint, per Annex 2:
a_en: Two Class A supervisors, two safety/hygiene management specialists and three OSH administrators
b_en: One Class C supervisor, one safety/hygiene management specialist and four OSH administrators
c_en: One Class B supervisor, two safety/hygiene management specialists and one OSH administrator
d_en: One Class A supervisor, one safety/hygiene management specialist and two OSH administrators
explain_zh: 附表二：營造業三百人以上未滿五百人者，置甲種業務主管一人、職業安全（衛生）管理師一人及職業安全衛生管理員二人；五百人以上者甲種業務主管一人、管理師及管理員各二人以上。
explain_en: Annex 2: 300–499 workers → Class A supervisor + 1 specialist + 2 administrators; 500+ → Class A supervisor + at least 2 specialists and 2 administrators.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第一類事業（營造業以外）勞工人數五百人以上未滿一千人者，依附表二應置何種人員？
a_zh: 乙種業務主管一人、職業安全（衛生）管理師一人及職業安全衛生管理員三人
b_zh: 甲種業務主管一人、職業安全（衛生）管理師二人及職業安全衛生管理員一人
c_zh: 甲種業務主管二人、職業安全（衛生）管理師二人及職業安全衛生管理員二人
d_zh: 甲種業務主管一人、職業安全（衛生）管理師一人及職業安全衛生管理員二人
q_en: A non-construction Category 1 enterprise with 500 to under 1,000 workers must appoint, per Annex 2:
a_en: One Class B supervisor, one management specialist and three administrators
b_en: One Class A supervisor, two management specialists and one administrator
c_en: Two Class A supervisors, two management specialists and two administrators
d_en: One Class A supervisor, one management specialist and two administrators
explain_zh: 附表二：營造業以外之第一類事業，一百人以上未滿三百人置甲種業務主管及管理員各一人；三百人以上未滿五百人置甲種業務主管一人、管理師及管理員各一人；五百人以上未滿一千人置甲種業務主管一人、管理師一人及管理員二人；一千人以上置甲種業務主管一人、管理師及管理員各二人以上。
explain_en: Annex 2 (non-construction Category 1): 100–299 → A + 1 admin; 300–499 → A + 1 specialist + 1 admin; 500–999 → A + 1 specialist + 2 admins; 1,000+ → A + at least 2 specialists and 2 admins.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第二類事業勞工人數三百人以上未滿五百人者，依附表二應置何種人員？
a_zh: 甲種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理員各一人
b_zh: 甲種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理師各二人
c_zh: 乙種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理員各二人
d_zh: 丙種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理師各一人
q_en: A Category 2 enterprise with 300 to under 500 workers must appoint, per Annex 2:
a_en: One Class A OSH business supervisor and one OSH administrator
b_en: Two Class A OSH business supervisors and two management specialists
c_en: One Class B OSH business supervisor and two OSH administrators
d_en: One Class C OSH business supervisor and one management specialist
explain_zh: 附表二：第二類事業一百人以上未滿三百人置甲種業務主管；三百人以上未滿五百人置甲種業務主管及管理員各一人；五百人以上置甲種業務主管、管理師及管理員各一人以上。
explain_en: Annex 2 (Category 2): 100–299 → Class A supervisor; 300–499 → A + 1 administrator; 500+ → A + at least 1 specialist and 1 administrator.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第三類事業勞工人數五百人以上者，依附表二應置何種人員？
a_zh: 甲種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理員各一人以上
b_zh: 甲種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理師各三人以上
c_zh: 丙種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理師各一人以上
d_zh: 乙種職業安全衛生業務主管及職業安全衛生管理員各二人以上
q_en: A Category 3 enterprise with 500 or more workers must appoint, per Annex 2:
a_en: At least one Class A OSH business supervisor and one OSH administrator
b_en: At least three Class A OSH business supervisors and one management specialist
c_en: At least one Class C OSH business supervisor and one management specialist
d_en: At least two Class B OSH business supervisors and two OSH administrators
explain_zh: 附表二：第三類事業未滿三十人丙種、三十至九十九人乙種、一百至四百九十九人甲種業務主管；五百人以上置甲種業務主管及管理員各一人以上。
explain_en: Annex 2 (Category 3): under 30 → C; 30–99 → B; 100–499 → A; 500+ → A plus at least one administrator.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 依附表二附註，置職業安全（衛生）管理師二人以上者，其中至少一人應為何種資格？
a_zh: 職業安全衛生管理員
b_zh: 工業安全技師
c_zh: 職業衛生管理師
d_zh: 職業安全管理師
q_en: Per the note to Annex 2, when two or more management specialists are appointed, at least one must be:
a_en: An occupational safety and health administrator
b_en: An industrial safety professional engineer
c_en: An occupational hygiene management specialist
d_en: An occupational safety management specialist
explain_zh: 附表二附註1：置職業安全（衛生）管理師二人以上者，其中至少一人應為職業衛生管理師；但於103年7月3日前已置有職業安全衛生人員者不在此限。附註2：本表為至少人數，仍應依規模及危害風險增置。
explain_en: Annex 2 note 1: at least one hygiene specialist (grandfathered before 3 July 2014); note 2: the table is a minimum.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 營造業之事業單位對於橋樑、道路、隧道或輸配電等距離較長之工程，應於每幾公里內增置營造業丙種職業安全衛生業務主管一人？
a_zh: 五公里
b_zh: 十公里
c_zh: 二十公里
d_zh: 三公里
q_en: For long linear construction projects such as bridges, roads, tunnels or power lines, one additional Class C construction OSH supervisor is required for every:
a_en: 5 km
b_en: 10 km
c_en: 20 km
d_en: 3 km
explain_zh: 第3條之1第2項：營造業對於橋樑、道路、隧道或輸配電等距離較長之工程，應於每十公里內增置營造業丙種職業安全衛生業務主管一人。
explain_en: Article 3-1(2): one additional Class C construction OSH business supervisor per 10 km.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第一類事業之事業單位對於所屬從事製造之一級單位，勞工人數在一百人以上未滿三百人者，應另置何人？
a_zh: 甲種職業安全衛生業務主管一人
b_zh: 丁種職業安全衛生業務主管一人
c_zh: 職業安全管理師一人
d_zh: 職業衛生管理師一人
q_en: In a Category 1 enterprise, a manufacturing first-level unit with 100 to under 300 workers must additionally have:
a_en: One Class A OSH business supervisor
b_en: One Class D OSH business supervisor
c_en: One occupational safety management specialist
d_en: One occupational hygiene management specialist
explain_zh: 第3條之1第1項：第一類事業對於所屬從事製造之一級單位，勞工人數一百人以上未滿三百人者應另置甲種職業安全衛生業務主管一人；三百人以上者應再至少增置專職職業安全衛生管理員一人。
explain_en: Article 3-1(1): a Class A OSH business supervisor for 100–299 workers; 300+ also requires at least one additional full-time OSH administrator.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 事業單位勞工人數之計算，是否包含承攬人、再承攬人之勞工？
a_zh: 包含，以同一期間同一工作場所作業之總人數計
b_zh: 由雇主自行認定，不受同一工作場所之限制
c_zh: 不包含，僅計算原事業單位自僱勞工之人數
d_zh: 僅包含承攬人，再承攬人之勞工不列入計算
q_en: Does the worker headcount include contractors' and subcontractors' workers?
a_en: Yes, the total working at the same time and place
b_en: At the employer's discretion for each workplace
c_en: No, only the enterprise's own hired workers
d_en: Contractors only; subcontractors are excluded
explain_zh: 第3條之2：勞工人數之計算，包含原事業單位及其承攬人、再承攬人之勞工及其他受工作場所負責人指揮或監督從事勞動之人員，於同一期間、同一工作場所作業時之總人數；設有總機構者包含各地區事業單位作業勞工人數。
explain_en: Article 3-2: includes the enterprise's own, contractors', subcontractors' workers and others under the workplace manager's direction, working in the same period at the same workplace.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 事業單位勞工人數未滿幾人者，雇主或其代理人經職業安全衛生業務主管教育訓練合格，得擔任該事業單位職業安全衛生業務主管？
a_zh: 五十人
b_zh: 五人
c_zh: 三十人
d_zh: 一百人
q_en: In enterprises with fewer than how many workers may the employer or a representative, having passed the OSH business supervisor training, act as the OSH business supervisor?
explain_zh: 第4條：勞工人數未滿三十人者，雇主或其代理人經業務主管教育訓練合格得擔任業務主管；第二類及第三類事業且勞工五人以下者，得由丁種業務主管訓練合格之雇主或代理人擔任。
explain_en: Article 4: fewer than 30 workers; for Category 2/3 enterprises with 5 or fewer workers, a Class D-trained employer or representative may serve.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第二類及第三類事業之事業單位，勞工人數在幾人以下者，得由丁種職業安全衛生業務主管教育訓練合格之雇主或其代理人擔任業務主管？
a_zh: 十人以下
b_zh: 五人以下
c_zh: 二十人以下
d_zh: 三十人以下
q_en: For Category 2 or 3 enterprises with how many workers or fewer may a Class D-trained employer or representative serve as OSH business supervisor?
a_en: 10 or fewer
b_en: 5 or fewer
c_en: 20 or fewer
d_en: 30 or fewer
explain_zh: 第4條但書：屬第二類及第三類事業之事業單位，且勞工人數在五人以下者，得由經丁種職業安全衛生業務主管教育訓練合格之雇主或其代理人擔任。
explain_en: Article 4 proviso: Category 2/3 enterprises with 5 or fewer workers.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
category: 職安管理辦法-條文沿革
q_zh: 職業安全衛生管理辦法歷經多次修正，下列哪一組條文之現行條文均已刪除而無實質內容？
a_zh: 第八十二條、第八十五條、第八十八條及第八十九條之一，現行條文均已刪除
b_zh: 第十三條、第十四條、第十五條及第八十條等四條條文，現行條文均已刪除
c_zh: 第五條、第九條、第七十六條及第八十九條等四條條文，現行條文均已刪除
d_zh: 第十條、第十一條、第十二條及第八十七條等四條條文，現行條文均已刪除
q_en: Which group of articles in these Regulations has been deleted in the current text?
a_en: Articles 82, 85, 88 and 89-1 have all been deleted from the current text
b_en: Articles 13, 14, 15 and 80 have all been deleted from the current text
c_en: Articles 5, 9, 76 and 89 have all been deleted from the current text
d_en: Articles 10, 11, 12 and 87 have all been deleted from the current text
explain_zh: 本辦法第5條、第9條、第76條、第89條均已刪除。相對地，第10條仍規定應設職業安全衛生委員會，第87條規定委員會名冊之登錄備查，第89條之1、第89條之2亦均為現行有效條文。
explain_en: Articles 5, 9, 76 and 89 are deleted.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 依職業安全衛生管理辦法，職業安全衛生委員會之職責為何？
a_zh: 查核安全衛生管理事項之執行，並代雇主簽署管理計畫及檢查紀錄
b_zh: 綜理及督導工作場所之安全衛生管理事項，並指揮所屬人員執行業務
c_zh: 擬訂、規劃、推動及督導安全衛生管理事項，並指導有關部門確實實施
d_zh: 對雇主擬訂之安全衛生政策提出建議，並審議、協調、考核及建議安全衛生相關事項
q_en: Under the Regulations, what is the duty of the OSH committee?
a_en: Audit the implementation of OSH matters and sign the management plan and inspection records
b_en: Oversee all OSH management matters of the workplace and direct subordinate staff in carrying them out
c_en: Draft, plan, promote and supervise OSH management matters and guide departments in implementing them
d_en: Advise on the employer's OSH policy and deliberate, coordinate, evaluate and recommend OSH matters
explain_zh: 第5條之1：管理單位擬訂規劃推動督導並指導部門實施；委員會對政策提出建議並審議協調考核建議；管理師／管理員擬訂規劃推動查核並指導實施；工作場所負責人綜理工作場所安全衛生管理事項；各級主管依職責指揮監督所屬執行。
explain_en: Article 5-1: management unit drafts/plans/promotes/supervises; committee advises on policy and deliberates/coordinates/evaluates; specialists and administrators draft/plan/promote/audit; the workplace manager oversees; line managers direct and supervise.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 事業單位未置有職業安全（衛生）管理師、職業安全衛生管理員者，其職業安全衛生業務主管之職責為何？
a_zh: 主管、督導及考核安全衛生管理事項
b_zh: 審議、協調及建議安全衛生相關事項
c_zh: 擬訂、規劃、推動及查核安全衛生管理事項
d_zh: 指揮、監督所屬執行安全衛生管理事項
q_en: If an enterprise has no OSH management specialist or administrator, the OSH business supervisor's duty is to:
a_en: Direct, supervise and evaluate OSH management matters
b_en: Deliberate, coordinate and recommend OSH-related matters
c_en: Draft, plan, promote and audit OSH management matters
d_en: Direct and supervise subordinates in OSH management work
explain_zh: 第5條之1第3款：置有管理師、管理員者，業務主管主管及督導安全衛生管理事項；未置有者，業務主管擬訂、規劃、推動及查核安全衛生管理事項。
explain_en: Article 5-1(3): with specialists/administrators the supervisor directs and oversees; without them the supervisor drafts, plans, promotes and audits.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 事業設有總機構者，第一類事業勞工人數在幾人以上，應於總機構設直接隸屬雇主之專責一級管理單位？第三類事業幾人以上應設管理單位？
a_zh: 五百人；三千人
b_zh: 一百人；五百人
c_zh: 三百人；一千人
d_zh: 一千人；五千人
q_en: For an enterprise with a head office, a Category 1 enterprise with how many workers needs a dedicated first-level unit at head office, and Category 3 with how many needs a management unit?
explain_zh: 第6條第2項：設有總機構者，第一類事業五百人以上應設直接隸屬雇主之專責一級管理單位；第二類事業五百人以上應設直接隸屬雇主之一級管理單位；第三類事業三千人以上應設管理單位；所置管理人員應為專職（第二、三類之業務主管除外）。
explain_en: Article 6(2): Category 1 with 500+ → dedicated first-level unit; Category 2 with 500+ → first-level unit; Category 3 with 3,000+ → management unit; personnel full-time except Category 2/3 business supervisors.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 第一類事業單位已實施職業安全衛生管理系統，管理績效經中央主管機關審查通過者，得不受何種限制？
a_zh: 機械設備實施定期檢查及重點檢查之限制
b_zh: 管理人員應接受安全衛生教育訓練之限制
c_zh: 一級管理單位應為專責及業務主管應為專職之限制
d_zh: 設置職業安全衛生委員會及置勞工代表之限制
q_en: A Category 1 enterprise with an OSH management system whose performance has been approved by the central authority is exempt from:
a_en: The requirement to carry out periodic and focused inspections of machinery and equipment
b_en: The requirement that management personnel receive OSH education and training
c_en: The requirements that the first-level unit be dedicated and the business supervisor full-time
d_en: The requirement to establish an OSH committee with labor representatives on it
explain_zh: 第6條之1：第一類事業單位或其總機構已實施第12條之2管理系統相關管理制度，管理績效經中央主管機關審查通過者，得不受第2條之1、第3條及第6條有關一級管理單位應為專責及業務主管應為專職之限制。
explain_en: Article 6-1: exempt from the dedicated-unit and full-time-supervisor requirements of Articles 2-1, 3 and 6.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 下列何者為職業安全衛生管理員之資格之一？
a_zh: 領有職業安全衛生管理乙級技術士證照
b_zh: 具工業安全技師資格
c_zh: 高等考試職業安全衛生類科錄取
d_zh: 領有職業安全管理甲級技術士證照
q_en: Which is a qualification for an OSH administrator?
a_en: Class B technician certificate in OSH management
b_en: Industrial safety engineer (技師) license
c_en: Passing the senior civil service OSH exam
d_en: Class A technician certificate in occupational safety management
explain_zh: 第7條第2項第3款：職業安全衛生管理員資格：具管理師資格；領有職業安全衛生管理乙級技術士證照；曾任勞動檢查員具二年以上檢查經驗；普通考試職業安全衛生類科錄取（大專相關科系畢業之目自103年7月1日不再適用）。其他選項為管理師資格。
explain_en: Article 7(2)(3): administrator qualifications include a Class B OSH management technician certificate, 2+ years as a labor inspector, or passing the junior civil service exam; the other options are specialist-level qualifications.

law: 職業安全衛生管理辦法
q_zh: 職業安全管理師之資格，曾任勞動檢查員者須具有職業安全檢查工作經驗幾年以上？
a_zh: 一年以上
b_zh: 五年以上
c_zh: 二年以上
d_zh: 三年以上
q_en: A former labor inspector qualifies as an occupational safety management specialist with how many years of safety inspection experience?
